This pioneering spirit continues to guide us today as we innovate and expand, push beyond the boundaries of our industry, and shape its future. From working exclusively with hedge funds to serving all alternatives, corporations and private clients, our organization has grown immensely across asset classes and geographies. For us, this progress is a pattern that we’ll only maintain as we move forward, always prioritizing our performance. So for those who want to play at the top of their game and be at the vanguard of their space, we say: Welcome to Citco.

About The Team & Business Line

Fund Administration is Citco’s core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry’s most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience.

A challenging and exciting role in a rapidly growing industry, Portfolio Analytics services across a diverse client base spanning hedge funds, private markets and multi-asset strategies across North America, the United Kingdom, Continental Europe and Asia. The Vice President of the Portfolio Analytics group will take a senior leadership role managing existing US client relationships, ensuring client retention, and driving sales, marketing and business development initiatives across the region. The team provides ad-hoc and regulatory risk reports that include, but are not limited to, exposure and P&L reports, limits monitoring, scenario analysis, stress testing, value-at-risk and fund performance analytics - supporting clients across a broad range of strategies and structures.

The role provides a unique opportunity to work closely with a wide range of securities, derivatives and structured products in many currencies traded across global markets, and to lead the build-out of a structured, high-performing client service model across the US book. The individual's duties will include, but are not limited to, client onboarding project management, senior client relationship leadership, team management, and the training and development of staff — mirroring and helping to embed a proven operating model already established elsewhere in the group.

Responsibilities

Your Role:

Business Development & Commercial Acumen — Take an active, leading role in the CFS 'new business acquisition' process from a Portfolio Analytics perspective, effectively demonstrating our suite of Portfolio Analytics services to potential clients as well as new or enhanced services to existing clients, positioning this as a core driver of the role; evaluate the viability of current and new business proposals with emphasis on tactical issues and barriers
Client Relationship Management — Own and lead senior client relationships across the US book, participating in regular client calls and working closely with the global Client Integration team who oversee and project manage the firm-wide onboarding process
Reporting of Client KPIs — Own and maintain the KPI and RAG framework across the US client base, supervising junior team members in day-to-day tracking and reporting to support senior management oversight
Team Leadership & Management — Provide day-to-day leadership and management of the US Portfolio Analytics team, embedding a structured, KPI-driven client service model and ensuring consistent standards of client oversight and RAG reporting across the book
Communication — Use appropriate interpersonal styles and techniques to gain acceptance and help others understand the importance of the vision on the day-to-day reality of the risk reporting process
Building Networks - Proactively build strong relationships with Client Service and Business Development colleagues across CFS offices as a first priority, while also networking across departments (Valuation/Profit & Loss, Operations, Internal Audit, Integration, etc.) to establish collaborative business relationships at all levels and facilitate the accomplishment of business objectives
Leading & Managing Others — Embody the CFS culture, lead and inspire team through change, encourage others to seek opportunities for different approaches to address problems and opportunities
Organization & Resource Management — Oversee the US team with responsibility for pre-sales, onboarding, client coverage planning, and other new business initiatives
Building and Retaining Organizational Talent —Focus on identifying, developing, deploying and retaining key talent within the US team (including succession planning) for the future success of CFS, initiating strategies to develop internal talent through ongoing training and conducting timely performance evaluations.
Operational Decision-making — Commit and take responsibility for tactical decisions, adopting innovative approaches to move resolution of challenges to completion; communicate outcomes to all stakeholders and contribute to CFS vision and strategy
Execution — Execute business strategy by aligning communication, accountabilities, skills, internal processes and measurement to ensure sustainable and profitable results
Client Risk & Continuity Oversight — Identify and manage clients with elevated customisation and key person risk, ensuring documented continuity plans are in place and escalating concentration risk where appropriate

Qualifications

About You:

Drive for Results — Possessing an energetic and tenacious achievement orientation; proactively seeking opportunities to drive performance of self and team, and setting stretching goals; managing personal and group strengths and opportunities
Navigating Complexity — Proactively and quickly making sense of complex issues where ambiguity exists; communicating complicated information concisely and logically
Excellent analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with proven ability to summarise and interpret client requirements
Aspiration to become a subject matter expert in proprietary risk solutions
Someone who enjoys project-based work, collaboration across teams, and dealing directly with clients — no two days the same
Quantitative background with a Bachelor's/higher level degree or professional qualification (MSc, PhD, CQF, FRM, PRMIA, GARP, CFA, FIA)
Proficient in Excel, VBA, SQL, with Python experience in particular advantageous
Knowledge of business intelligence tools such as Qlik Sense (or Tableau) and Jaspersoft is a plus
7–10 years' experience in investment and regulatory risk reporting and performance analytics in funds/asset management/banking/insurance - including hedge fund, private markets and multi-asset strategies , with demonstrated experience in client relationship leadership, team management, pre-sales, onboarding and business development
Prior experience managing or supervising a client-facing team is required
Knowledge of market, credit, liquidity and counterparty risk measurement and management under regulatory frameworks such as Form PF, Form CPO-PQR, Annex IV, Basel III/CRD IV/CRR and Solvency II is advantageous
Candidates must be willing to travel to the United States for business purposes

jobs.title: Head of Artificial Intelligence
jobs.description:
Enterprise AI | Manufacturing | Supply Chain | Private Label | Business Transformation

Scope:
Enterprise-wide, multi-site
Locations:
Toronto, Wixom, Chicago and Sardis; regular site travel required
Role model:
High-leverage individual contributor / transformation owner, supported by internal teams, vendors and consultants
Primary measure:
Measurable business value from AI-enabled process and decision improvement

About the Company

The company is a large contract manufacturer and packager of household cleaning products serving branded and private-label customers across North America.

Position Overview

This position will define and drive the company’s practical adoption of artificial intelligence across the business. This is not primarily an IT infrastructure, software development or research role. It is a business transformation role for someone who can understand how the company makes money, how its plants and customer programs operate, where decisions and processes break down, and where AI can create measurable advantage.
The person will own the AI opportunity portfolio from discovery through value realization: identifying and sizing high-value use cases, redesigning workflows and decision processes, determining data and technology requirements, coordinating internal and external technical resources, guiding pilots into scaled deployment, building organizational capability, and measuring financial and operational results.
The role will initially operate as a high-leverage individual contributor. Success depends less on personally building every model and more on asking the right questions, selecting the right problems, challenging vendors and specialists, and ensuring solutions are adopted in the business and sustained.

Core Mandate

Build a phased enterprise AI roadmap tied directly to company business priorities, plant economics and customer-program economics.
Create a repeatable method for finding, evaluating and prioritizing AI opportunities based on value, feasibility, data readiness, adoption requirements and risk.
Turn selected opportunities into implemented solutions that change how work is performed and how decisions are made, rather than producing disconnected pilots or demonstrations.
Develop the internal operating model, governance, external partner ecosystem and AI literacy required to scale successful solutions across facilities and functions.
Own value realization: each meaningful initiative should have a baseline, business case, accountable owner, adoption plan and measurable outcome.

Key Responsibilities

1. AI Strategy, Opportunity Portfolio & Roadmap
Develop and maintain the enterprise AI transformation roadmap across manufacturing, supply chain, procurement, quality, R&D/formulation, commercialization, commercial/customer processes, finance and supporting functions.
Build a decision and process inventory to identify repetitive, high-value, data-rich business situations where AI, automation or advanced analytics can materially improve outcomes.
Prioritize use cases by expected economic value, strategic importance, feasibility, data readiness, scalability, change impact and risk; stop low-value or poorly grounded initiatives early.
Continuously assess the AI landscape—including generative AI, agents, machine learning, computer vision, optimization, digital twins and industrial AI—and translate relevant advances into practical recommendations for the company.

2. Manufacturing & Intelligent Operations
Work directly with plant, engineering, maintenance, quality and operations leaders to identify AI-enabled improvements in process control, batch optimization, yield, quality, line performance, changeovers, reliability, downtime, energy, waste and safety.
Identify opportunities for predictive quality, predictive maintenance, machine vision, intelligent scheduling, digital twins and decision support where the operational data and economics justify them.
Design pilots with clear operating baselines and success measures, then create the playbook required to replicate proven solutions across relevant sites and assets.
Ensure AI is embedded into standard operating processes and decision routines with appropriate human oversight, rather than operating as a separate technology layer.

3. Contract Manufacturing, Customer Programs & Commercialization
Apply AI to the full customer-program lifecycle, including opportunity identification, RFQ/quoting, formulation and product development, packaging/specification management, commercialization, production readiness, fulfillment and ongoing program profitability.
Develop better decision support around bid/no-bid, pricing floors, capacity implications, changeover burden, working capital, forecast reliability, customer service requirements and true program economics.
Explore AI-enabled customer and category intelligence that can identify assortment gaps, private-label opportunities, cross-sell opportunities, packaging gaps and product concepts the company can proactively bring to customers.
Use connected data to improve launch execution, specification/artwork consistency, retailer/customer compliance, deductions/chargebacks and root-cause learning from complaints and service failures.

4. Supply Chain, Procurement & Planning
Identify AI opportunities in forecasting, S&OP/IBP, inventory, raw-material planning, procurement, sourcing, supplier intelligence, production scheduling, warehousing and transportation.
Improve the company’s ability to predict customer demand and forecast reliability, allocate capacity and materials, sequence production and manage working capital under uncertainty.
Use AI to surface exceptions and recommended actions so teams can spend less time assembling information and more time resolving the decisions that matter.

5. Data, Technology & Partner Orchestration
Define practical data-readiness requirements for AI use cases and work with IT, plant systems, Finance, Quality, R&D and other data owners to improve access, context and reliability.
Evaluate AI platforms, specialist vendors, consultants and implementation partners based on business fit, architecture, security, scalability, interoperability, total cost and expected value.
Make informed build-vs-buy-vs-partner recommendations and ensure the company retains appropriate knowledge, control and portability as capabilities scale.
Act as the business product owner for AI initiatives while technical specialists own the detailed engineering, infrastructure and model construction where appropriate.

6. Governance, Risk & Responsible AI
Establish proportionate AI governance covering privacy, cybersecurity, customer confidentiality and IP, data access, model risk, human oversight, transparency, validation and regulatory requirements.
Create clear decision rights defining where AI may inform, recommend or execute, and where human approval remains required.
Ensure use cases involving regulated products, quality systems or customer-sensitive information are developed and validated with the appropriate functional experts.

7. Change, Adoption & Capability Building
Build AI literacy among executives, plant leaders, managers and frontline users through practical education tied to the company’s work rather than generic technology training.
Create a network of functional and site champions who can identify opportunities, support adoption and help scale what works.
Address resistance, role changes, trust and skill gaps directly; redesign processes and responsibilities where AI changes how work should be performed.
Communicate wins, failures and lessons openly so the organization becomes progressively better at selecting and deploying AI.

8. Value Realization & Executive Reporting
Build business cases and establish measurable baselines before meaningful investment is made.
Track value across cost, margin, working capital, throughput, yield, quality, service, innovation speed, risk reduction and employee productivity as relevant to each use case.
Maintain a portfolio view of AI investments, adoption and realized value, and report progress, risks and priorities to senior leadership.
Treat adoption and sustained operating impact—not the number of pilots launched—as the primary definition of success.

Illustrative Initial Opportunity Areas

Manufacturing:
Batch/process optimization; predictive quality; machine vision; maintenance/reliability; line scheduling/changeovers; energy, yield and waste.
Product & R&D:
Formulation optimization; raw-material substitution; experiment prioritization; specification knowledge; faster customer/product development.
Supply Chain:
Demand forecasting; customer forecast quality; inventory; procurement; supplier intelligence; production planning; logistics and working capital.
Private Label / Commercial:
RFQ and quote intelligence; bid/no-bid; customer/program profitability; assortment whitespace; cross-sell; customer opportunity intelligence.
Commercialization & Quality:
Launch control tower; specification/artwork consistency; complaints-to-root-cause; regulatory/product-stewardship impact analysis; customer compliance.
Knowledge & Administration:
Plant/SOP/maintenance knowledge assistants; document processing; management reporting; finance and back-office workflow automation.

Candidate Profile

The strongest candidate is likely an experienced manufacturing, operations, supply-chain, analytics or business-transformation leader who has become sophisticated in AI—not necessarily a career AI researcher or software engineer. Because modern generative AI and agent technologies are new, depth of practical use and demonstrated outcomes matter more than an arbitrary number of years with “AI” in a title.
Typically 10+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing, operations, supply chain, digital/business transformation, advanced analytics or a closely related environment.
Demonstrated recent ownership of meaningful AI, advanced-analytics, automation or digital-transformation initiatives from problem definition through deployment and measurable business impact.
Strong understanding of manufacturing economics and operational processes; experience in process manufacturing, CPG, chemicals, private label, contract manufacturing or other complex multi-site industrial environments is strongly preferred.
Practical fluency in current AI capabilities, including generative AI, AI agents, machine learning, predictive analytics, optimization, computer vision and intelligent automation. The candidate does not need to personally code every solution, but must understand enough to challenge technical assumptions and vendors.
Strong financial and business acumen: can build a credible business case, quantify value, understand trade-offs and distinguish an interesting technology from an investable business opportunity.
Proven ability to lead through influence across plant operations, engineering, supply chain, quality, R&D, Finance, IT/data teams and senior leadership without necessarily owning those functions directly.
Experience working with external consultants, software/platform providers and specialist technical partners; capable of making build/buy/partner decisions.
Excellent facilitation and communication skills, from plant-floor working sessions to executive presentations.
Comfort with ambiguity and an entrepreneurial bias toward practical experimentation, learning and scale.
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Business, Computer/Data Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Advanced degree is beneficial but not required.
Ability and willingness to travel regularly among company facilities as projects require.

What Success Looks Like

First 90 Days
Visit key company sites and build a grounded view of operations, customer-program workflows, current systems/data and organizational readiness.
Create an enterprise AI opportunity map and prioritized initial roadmap with business cases, data requirements,

About The Role

This role requires a strong foundation in data science and advanced analytics
. You should be comfortable working with sophisticated analytical methodologies, evaluating data science approaches and outputs, and translating complex quantitative findings into clear business recommendations.

At the Associate Director level, you will also lead teams and workstreams, influence senior stakeholders, and help shape the analytical approach to complex client challenges. You may not be coding or building models every day, but you should have sufficient data science depth to credibly guide the work and challenge the methodology.

Data Science & Advanced Analytics

Lead advanced analytics and data science work across complex client engagements. Apply and guide approaches such as statistical modeling, predictive analytics, experimentation, segmentation, forecasting, machine learning, or other advanced quantitative methodologies as appropriate to the business problem.

Evaluate analytical approaches and outputs, identify limitations and opportunities, and ensure that methodologies are rigorous, actionable, and connected to client objectives.

Complex Program & Engagement Leadership

Strategic Analytics & Client Advisory

Team & Technical Leadership

Lead and develop analytics and data science talent, set expectations for analytical quality, and provide guidance on methodologies and approaches across multiple workstreams.

Partner effectively with data scientists, analysts, media teams, strategists, engineers, and other specialists to deliver integrated solutions.

Client Advisory & Growth

Build credible senior client relationships and identify opportunities where analytics, data science, measurement, or AI capabilities can address additional client needs.

AI-Enabled Delivery & Innovation

Identify qualified AI use cases and opportunities to incorporate AI-enabled approaches into analytics and measurement. Help evaluate where emerging technologies can create measurable value rather than applying AI for its own sake.

Experience leading complex analytics or data science projects from business problem definition through analysis, interpretation, and recommendation
Ability to evaluate and guide sophisticated analytical work, including methodology, assumptions, limitations, and business implications

Experience partnering with or leading data scientists, analysts, and other technical specialists
Experience leading and developing teams
Demonstrated influence across functions, client teams, or portfolios
Credible senior client relationships and the ability to advise, not just deliver
Emerging account-economics literacy, including utilization, scope, and margin within a remit

Strong Plus

Hands-on experience with programming and analytical tools such as SQL, Python, R, or similar
Experience with experimentation, causal inference, marketing measurement, incrementality, attribution, or other advanced measurement approaches
Experience applying machine learning or predictive modeling to marketing or business problems
Experience integrating GenAI or agentic platforms with measurable outcomes
Quantified contribution to account growth or scope expansion

jobs.description:
About the Role

We’re building a relationship-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.

At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.

To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com

What you'll be doing

Our AI team builds enterprise capabilities that support a wide range of users across the organization, from end users to technology teams and low-code or no-code builders. As a Principal Product Scaler – AI Engineering, you'll build the engineering foundation that helps us repeatedly deliver high-quality AI products safely, efficiently, and at scale. You'll architect and develop the reusable components, software development kits, testing frameworks, and delivery patterns that move us from individual implementations to a mature product engineering model. You'll establish the standards for how AI products are designed, built, tested, packaged, released, and monitored in production. Working closely with data scientists, engineers, and technology partners, you'll help turn strong prototypes into reliable enterprise products while strengthening the team's overall engineering capability.

At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (proportion of on-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.

Build scalable engineering foundations

Establish engineering excellence -
Define and implement standards for code structure, testing, code review, versioning, packaging, documentation, release management, and production readiness for AI and Generative AI products.
Advance AI quality and reliability

Enable adoption across teams -

jobs.description:
EvenUp is on a mission to close the justice gap using technology and AI. We empower personal injury lawyers and victims to get the justice they deserve. Our products enable law firms to secure faster settlements, higher payouts, and better outcomes for victims injured through no fault of their own in vehicle collisions, accidents, natural disasters, and more.

We are one of the fastest-growing vertical SaaS companies in history, and we are just getting started. EvenUp is backed by top VCs, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Bain Capital Ventures, SignalFire, and Lightspeed. We are looking to expand our team with talented, driven, and collaborative individuals who seek to have a lasting impact. Learn more at www.evenuplaw.com.

The Director of FP&A, R&D acts as the strategic finance partner to Engineering, Product, and Data/ML leadership, owning the R&D operating plan and establishing LLM economics as a fundamental financial discipline. This role manages the P&L for R&D headcount and Cost of Revenue (CoR) for AI in production, driving efficiency through direct engagement with our data stack (BigQuery/dbt).

What You'll Do

Partner day to day with engineering, product, and data leaders as their trusted finance counterpart.
Build the analyses that shape build-vs-buy, pricing, and infrastructure decisions.
Support foundation-model and cloud vendor negotiations with data-backed positions.
Deliver clear, concise reporting and variance commentary to the CFO, FP&A leadership, and the board.
Own the R&D budget, forecast, and headcount plan across Engineering, Product, and Data/ML. Drive the re-forecast cycle and keep hiring plans tied to output and priorities.
Make LLM/inference and cloud compute cost a first-class, closely monitored metric. Build the model that tracks unit costs; monitor spend daily; and partner with engineering to find and defend efficiency. This is not a monthly-close afterthought, it's a core operating metric of the business.
Own the connection between usage, inference cost, and gross margin. Model the margin impact of new products, pricing changes, and model/infrastructure choices, and make the tradeoffs legible to leadership.
Bring financial rigor to major R&D spend decisions including foundation-model and API contracts, cloud commitments, data, and dev tooling, including negotiation support and ROI cases.

What We Look For

8+ years in FP&A / corporate finance, with meaningful time supporting R&D, Engineering, or a technical/product org.
Deep comfort with SaaS and AI/usage-based economics: CoR, gross margin, unit economics, and how infrastructure/inference cost drives them.
Strong SQL (BigQuery a major plus) and expert Excel/Sheets modeling, with clean, maintainable model architecture.
Strong grasp of how R&D spend flows through the P&L.
Ability to be a genuine partner to technical leaders, holding substantive conversations with engineering or ML leads to translate technical work into financial views.
Precise, low-ego, self-directed, and concise work ethic.
Nice to have: Experience at a high-growth AI/ML company, familiarity with modern data stacks, contract negotiation experience, people management experience, and CPA/CA/CFA.
Nice to have: Familiarity with a modern data stack (dbt, EPMs) and building repeatable, auditable finance pipelines.

Benefits & Perks:

As part of our total rewards package, we offer attractive benefits and perks to our employees, including:

Choice of medical, dental, and vision insurance plans for you and your family.
Additional insurance coverage options for life, accident, or critical illness.
Flexible paid time off, sick leave, short-term and long-term disability.
10 US observed holidays, and Canadian statutory holidays by province.
A home office stipend.
401(k) for US-based employees and RRSP for Canada-based employees.
Paid parental leave.
A local in-person meet-up program.
Hubs in San Francisco and Toronto.

(Please note the above benefits & perks are for full-time employees)

Notice to Candidates:

To ensure fairness and proper consideration, we do not accept resumes or expressions of interest via email or social media messages. If you’re interested in a role, please submit your application directly through our careers page .

Please note that EvenUp may use AI notetakers and other recording devices in the recruiting process. If you interview with us, with your consent, we may record your conversations and summarize them into notes for internal use. Recording is optional, and declining will not affect your candidacy.

EvenUp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to diversity and inclusion in our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Compensation Range: $176K - $250K

on a permanent basis at our Refinery Business Office in Regina, SK
.

This is a unique opportunity for a seasoned refinery leader to leverage deep operational expertise, planning and optimization experience, and commercial acumen to influence enterprise-wide decisions and deliver meaningful business results.

What you’ll do:

Lead the development and execution of long-range and mid-range strategies that maximize profitability across the Energy Value Chain, aligning business, financial, and operational plans with corporate objectives.
Identify, evaluate, and advance gross margin improvement opportunities for our manufacturing assets and the integrated Energy Value Chain by integrating commercial, manufacturing, supply, and market insights to optimize enterprise value.
Drive cross-functional planning and decision-making across Manufacturing, Supply & Trading, Energy, Marketing, Finance, Regulatory Compliance, and other business partners to ensure alignment on priorities and outcomes.
Oversee the governance, evaluation, prioritization, and resource allocation of strategic projects and initiatives that support Energy Value Chain optimization and long-term business performance.
Establish and enhance planning, optimization, and performance management systems, processes, and analytics that enable effective execution, monitoring, and continuous improvement of business plans.
Provide leadership and direction to Strategy & Planning Analysis and Manufacturing Performance teams, building organizational capability in strategic planning, economic analysis, performance management, and business optimization.

Who you’ll work with:

The Team:
Reporting to the Vice President, Manufacturing, you will lead two Senior Managers and provide oversight and direction to a team of Strategy, Planning, and Performance Analysts, helping drive strategic planning, performance improvement, and margin optimization across the Energy Value Chain.

Why it matters:

We fuel Western Canada. Our Refinery strives to be a recognized leader in safety, reliability and sustainability within the petroleum-refining industry.

Who you are:

You are looking for a career in energy strategy, planning & performance and:
Have 10+ years of relevant progressive experience in the petroleum/refining industry with experience working at a leadership level.
Have extensive refinery operations experience, with a strong understanding of the technical, operational, and commercial drivers that influence business performance and profitability.
Have proven experience in strategic planning, performance management, economic analysis, and business optimization within a complex industrial environment.
Have demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and drive results. Experience with refinery planning and optimization, continuous improvement, industry benchmarking, regulatory compliance, or project management is considered an asset.

Competitive salaries, short-term incentives, a comprehensive benefits package, and an employer-contributed pension plan.

jobs.title: Director, Insights
jobs.description:
Dig Insights unites strategy, human understanding, and technology to help brands move decisively, in a world that won’t wait. We work with insights and marketing professionals at some of the world’s most well-loved brands, powering their brand and innovation decision-making. Dig One is our agile technology platform, used by our people and our clients, to deliver smarter and faster decisions.

Our clients span verticals including CPG, QSR, retail, technology, financial services, and telecommunications. Our work is led by a team of over 250 strategists, insights consultants, developers, and data scientists. We work for a global client base out of offices in Toronto, Chicago, London, and Singapore.

Since we started in 2010, we’ve been focused on setting a new standard for the insights industry – challenging the traditional model and building for what comes next. That means hiring people who are bright, creative, resourceful, and kind. People who succeed at Dig are curious, question established norms and are passionate about helping our clients to move their businesses forward. If you want to join a team that takes themselves just seriously enough to produce great work, we’d love to welcome you.

As we continue to grow, both geographically and in our expertise, we are looking for people who want to join a high-growth and highly collaborative company.

Dig insights is looking for a dedicated and passionate Director, Insights to join our growing Toronto office.

Director, Insights – About this role

Working closely with the Analysts, Managers and VP on their team, the Director provides essential support to their team to help execute and deliver client projects. The Director is responsible for delivering a final report including strategic insights/ research findings, summaries, and recommendations to the VP. The Director has demonstrated their research skills and knowledge and is a key contact for clients on any questions or clarifications. They can be relied on for project updates, recommendations on additional analysis required, working with other Dig team members to develop solutions to any project related problems and troubleshoot any issues that arise. The Director also acts as the day-to-day manager of the Analysts and Managers on the team, providing feedback, establishing goals, and helping to train the team on fundamentals, advance research techniques and report writing. In addition to growing their skill set as a researcher, the Directors at Dig are encouraged to take part in our company’s exciting culture and enjoy this dynamic stage in their career.

Your primary responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

Supporting the sales process through proposal development, including methodology design, costing, scheduling and design considerations.
Overseeing project management in its entirety ensuring timely, quality deliverables according to project design.
Managing a team by guiding data analysis and results communication to ensure projects are delivered with excellence.
Analysing results and creating a "story" that delivers insightful, strategic and actionable answers for clients.
Confidently presenting results to all levels of client organizations in a clear and compelling manner.
Providing advice, guidance and counselling to Research Analysts and Research Managers, including assessment and identification of training needs.
Developing and maintaining client relationships while identifying growth opportunities within existing accounts and consulting/participating in the selling process.

Experience, Skills and Requirements:

7 + years of direct and relevant experience.
University Degree or Post-Graduate Program in a relevant field (Market Research, Business Insights, Marketing, Statistics, or other).
Solid English communication skills, both written and oral are required.
Proficiency in SPSS and/or Q or other tabulations software.
Excellent skills in PowerPoint and Microsoft Office Suite are required.
Able to work within a fast-paced dynamic environment.
Effective interpersonal, communication and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
Ability to meet tight deadlines, while maintaining close attention to detail.
Ability to work independently and with a team.

Work Perks:

A hybrid-remote work environment, where employees have the flexibility to work remotely or from one of our offices
Unlimited vacation policy
Reimbursement for health and wellness classes/memberships and continuous learning
RRSP / 401K employer matching program
Offices in Toronto and Chicago, located steps to public transportation in the downtown core
Regular social events such as charity poker nights, trivia events, team building days, and more!

To find out more about us visit us at www.diginsights.com.

Our culture is built on 5 core values: Energy, Excellence, Evolution, Equality and Empathy. We believe that our success is dependent on the diverse talents, skills, and ideas of its staff. We are committed to creating an inclusive work environment and encourage applications from all qualified candidates including those in the BIPOC and LGBTQ communities, and from people with disabilities.

jobs.title: Director, HR Transformation, Systems and Analytics
jobs.description:
This is a hybrid position based out of our 243 Consumers Rd location in North York, with 4 days per week in office and 1 day remote.

Lifemark Health Group (LHG) is a market leader in customized healthcare solutions. With over 20 years of service excellence, LHG is one of the largest, most trusted, and most comprehensive providers in Canada. As a national healthcare company, LHG employs over 5,000 highly trained clinicians, medical experts and team members in almost 400 locations coast-to-coast and continues to grow both organically as well as through acquisitions. Lifemark was acquired by Loblaw Companies on May 10, 2022.

The Opportunity:

We are seeking a strategic, collaborative, and results-oriented Director, HR Transformation, Systems and Analytics to lead the evolution of Lifemark's HR operating model, technology capabilities, and people analytics function.

Reporting to the Vice President, People & Culture, this role will provide strategic leadership across HR transformation, systems, process optimization, data governance, and workforce analytics. The Director will be responsible for developing and executing a roadmap that strengthens HR operational effectiveness, establishes scalable processes and controls, improves data quality, and enables more informed people and business decisions.

A key priority will be leading Lifemark's readiness for a future Workday implementation, ensuring that HR processes, data, governance, systems, and organizational capabilities are positioned for successful transformation. The role will also oversee the effectiveness and continuous improvement of existing HR platforms while identifying opportunities to leverage technology, automation, and responsible AI to improve efficiency and the employee and manager experience.

Working closely with People & Culture leadership, Operations, Finance, Payroll, IT, Talent Acquisition, and Enterprise partners, the Director will translate business priorities into practical, sustainable solutions, lead cross-functional initiatives, and build the capabilities required to support Lifemark's continued growth and evolution.

Key Responsibilities:

HR Transformation, Strategy & Operating Model

Develop and execute a comprehensive HR transformation strategy and roadmap aligned with organizational priorities, business growth, and the evolving needs of the People & Culture function.
Lead the assessment and optimization of Lifemark's HR operating model, identifying opportunities to strengthen service delivery, accountability, governance, operational efficiency, and employee experience.
Establish consistent, scalable, and well-controlled HR processes across core employee lifecycle activities, including recruitment, onboarding, employee changes, position management, organizational changes, compensation-related workflows, and offboarding.
Lead current-state process assessments to identify gaps, duplication, manual workarounds, inefficiencies, and operational or compliance risks.
Oversee the development and implementation of standardized processes, operating procedures, governance frameworks, controls, and accountability structures.
Establish mechanisms to monitor process effectiveness, compliance, and adherence to established controls.
Identify and prioritize opportunities for process simplification, automation, and continuous improvement across People & Culture.
Lead transformation initiatives associated with organizational growth, acquisitions, integration activities, and evolving business requirements.
Develop business cases, implementation plans, success measures, and executive recommendations to support transformation investments and priorities.

HR Systems Strategy & Workday Readiness

Provide strategic and functional leadership for Lifemark's HR systems landscape, ensuring technology capabilities support business requirements, HR operations, data integrity, and employee and manager experience.
Develop and maintain an HR technology roadmap that balances current operational requirements, system optimization, future-state capabilities, and long-term transformation priorities.
Lead the development and execution of Lifemark's Workday readiness roadmap, establishing clear milestones, accountabilities, dependencies, risks, and decision points.
Assess organizational readiness across HR processes, data quality, governance, integrations, reporting, security roles, permissions, change impacts, and operating model requirements.
Partner with Enterprise HRIS, IT, Payroll, Finance, and other stakeholders to align HR technology priorities, integration requirements, and future-state system design.
Oversee the prioritization, planning, testing, and implementation of enhancements to existing HR systems, including configuration changes, workflow improvements, reporting capabilities, and process automation.
Establish appropriate governance and controls for HR system administration, access management, data maintenance, system changes, and issue resolution.
Identify and address foundational process, data, and governance gaps that may impact the success of future HR technology implementations.
Lead or support technology assessments, vendor engagement, business case development, solution design, and implementation planning as required.
Ensure effective change management, documentation, training, and stakeholder readiness for HR system and technology initiatives.

People Analytics, Reporting & Data Governance

Develop and lead Lifemark's people analytics and reporting strategy, enabling reliable, meaningful, and actionable workforce insights to support business and HR decision-making.
Establish consistent HR metrics, reporting standards, data definitions, and governance practices across the organization.
Oversee the development and continuous improvement of HR dashboards, scorecards, and management reporting related to workforce trends, headcount, turnover, recruitment, organizational structures, and other key people metrics.
Partner with People & Culture, Finance, Operations, and business leaders to identify reporting requirements and translate workforce data into actionable insights.
Lead initiatives to improve HR data quality, completeness, accuracy, consistency, and accessibility across systems and processes.
Establish data governance frameworks, ownership, validation processes, and controls to support the integrity and reliability of people data.
Identify opportunities to strengthen workforce planning, trend analysis, forecasting, and organizational decision-making through enhanced reporting and analytics.
Support the development of self-service reporting capabilities and standardized reporting tools to improve accessibility and reduce manual effort.
Ensure appropriate privacy, confidentiality, and data protection practices are embedded into HR reporting and analytics processes.
Present workforce insights, trends, risks, and recommendations to People & Culture leadership and business stakeholders.

Process Optimization, Automation & Responsible AI

Lead the identification and prioritization of opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate HR processes to improve efficiency, scalability, and service delivery.
Partner with Talent Acquisition to assess and optimize recruitment processes, from requisition intake through candidate selection, offer management, onboarding handoff, and reporting.
Evaluate opportunities to leverage automation, AI, and emerging technologies to improve HR operations, recruitment effectiveness, reporting, and employee and manager experiences.
Assess potential AI applications in recruitment and HR operations, including workflow automation, candidate communications, scheduling, reporting, document creation, and knowledge management.
Partner with Legal, Privacy, IT, Enterprise teams, and People & Culture leadership to ensure technology and AI recommendations align with organizational policies, ethical standards, privacy requirements, and applicable legislation.
Lead the implementation of approved process improvements, including change management, stakeholder engagement, training, and measurement of outcomes.
Establish performance indicators and continuous improvement mechanisms to evaluate operational efficiency, process effectiveness, and transformation benefits.

Leadership, Governance & Stakeholder Partnership

Build team capability and promote a culture of collaboration, innovation, continuous improvement, and strong internal customer service.
Establish effective governance structures, project oversight, and prioritization processes to ensure the successful delivery of strategic and operational initiatives.
Manage competing priorities, resources, project dependencies, and risks to ensure timely and high-quality execution.

Build strong partnerships with Operations, Finance, Payroll, IT, Legal, Talent Acquisition, and Enterprise teams to ensure coordinated and sustainable solutions.

jobs.title: Director, Supply Chain & Operations Finance
jobs.description:
Job Description

Who We Are:

At Arterra Wines Canada, we aim to inspire the simple joys of life, and we come to work every day with a shared passion to build wine brands people love. As a pioneer in the Canadian wine industry with 150 years of experience, our success is driven by our people. We work together with integrity and pride, striving to reach our fullest potential every day, and we’re looking for people who do the same.

We are undergoing a pivotal transformation, actively in search of dynamic individuals poised to make a substantial impact within our ever-evolving organization. Are you someone who embraces change and excels in diverse roles that span across various functions? If so, we look forward to hearing from you!

Role Summary

Provides strategic financial leadership & partnership to the Supply Chain organization. Acts as the bridge between Operations and Finance, delivering financial insights, inventory stewardship, capital investment governance, & performance management supporting operational excellence, productivity, cashflow & long-term value creation. This position has a hybrid work arrangement (3/days week in person), and can be based out of our Mississauga or Niagara Falls offices.

Key Responsibilities

BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT

Partner with Operations leadership to support supply chain, manufacturing, inventory, and operational strategies.
Provide financial insights and decision support on productivity initiatives, network optimization, strategic investments, and operating model improvements.
Assess financial implications of operational decisions across cost, service, inventory, cash flow, and profitability objectives.
Deliver scenario analysis and recommendations to support informed decision-making and long-term value creation.
Support acquisitions, integrations, transformations, and other strategic initiatives impacting Operations.
Partner with the EVP Supply Chain on multi-year value creation plans focused on productivity, inventory optimization, working capital improvement

CAPITAL STEWARDSHIP

Lead the annual and long-range capital planning process in partnership with Operations leadership.
Evaluate and prioritize capital investments based on strategic alignment, risk, return, and business impact.
Establish and maintain capital governance processes, including project approval, tracking, reporting, and benefit realization.
Monitor capital portfolio performance and challenge business case assumptions to ensure strong ROI outcomes.
Provide financial oversight of inventory investments, inventory valuation, inventory accuracy, and working capital performance.
Partner with Operations to ensure inventory strategies are aligned with business objectives and reflected appropriately in forecasts, budgets, and financial plans.

FINANCE EXCELLENCE

Provide financial stewardship of Operations results, including COGS, manufacturing costs, inventory, working capital, and capital investments.
Lead forecasting, reporting, and performance management processes that provide visibility into operational results and key business drivers.
Drive fixed and variable COGS analysis to identify productivity opportunities, cost drivers, manufacturing efficiencies, and margin improvement actions.
Deliver meaningful KPI reporting, variance analysis, and insights that drive accountability and business performance.
Champion the development and enhancement of Power BI dashboards and analytical tools that improve visibility and support decision-making.
Ensure appropriate controls, governance, and compliance related to inventory, capital expenditures, and operational financial processes.
Partner with FP&A and Controllership to ensure accurate financial reporting, inventory accounting, and forecasting assumptions.
Translate operational performance into clear financial implications, enabling proactive management of profitability, cash flow, inventory, and working capital.

TALENT DEVELOPMENT

Build and develop a high-performing Operations Finance team with strong analytical, business partnering, and leadership capabilities.
Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement
Develop organizational capabilities and succession plans to support future business needs.

What You Bring

8-10+ years of progressive Finance experience, including significant exposure to Operations Finance, Supply Chain Finance, or Plant Finance.
Demonstrated ability to translate complex operational and financial data into clear business insights and recommendations.
Experience simplifying processes, improving reporting systems, and designing new ways of working.
4+ years of people leadership experience, with a track record of developing high-performing teams.
Experience using JDE, JDA, Hyperion, or similar ERP/financial planning systems to enhance reporting and analytics.
Experience using Power BI or Tableau is an asset

jobs.description:
About The Role

The VP, Data and AI Foundations is an enterprise executive leadership role accountable for defining, governing, and executing SE Health's end-to-end data and AI ecosystem. This role owns the strategy, architecture, engineering, analytics, governance, and business integration of data and artificial intelligence assets across the organization.

This position provides executive oversight for enterprise data strategies, advanced analytics, machine learning/Generative AI capabilities, data architecture, information governance, business intelligence, and responsible AI ethics frameworks. The VP partners with senior executives, clinical operations, technology leadership, legal/privacy teams, and external strategic partners to transform raw enterprise data into actionable intelligence, predictive insights, automated workflows, and measurable business and clinical outcomes.

Enterprise Impact and Scope

Sets enterprise direction for data management, business intelligence, predictive/prescriptive analytics, and enterprise AI adoption strategies.
Accountable for establishing data quality, metadata management, data architecture integration, and AI ethical guardrails in alignment with organizational risk posture and regulatory standards.
Provides executive leadership for the design, scaling, and monetization/operationalization of machine learning models, Generative AI applications, and algorithmic automation.
Builds executive alignment, algorithmic trust, and scalable data-driven operating models that empower enterprise clinical, financial, and operational decision-making.

What You'll Do

Enterprise Data & AI Strategy, Investment & Governance

Enterprise Direction: Sets the enterprise vision, strategic priorities, operating model and multi-year roadmap for data and AI, aligned with SE Health’s organizational strategy, care transformation and growth objectives.
Investment Stewardship: Establishes portfolio priorities and provides executive oversight of operating and capital investments, business cases, funding recommendations and benefits realization across the data and AI portfolio.
Enterprise Standards: Establishes and approves enterprise standards for data architecture, quality, stewardship, interoperability, access, platforms and responsible AI, ensuring alignment with security, privacy, legal, clinical and regulatory requirements.
Decision Authority: Chairs or sponsors enterprise governance forums; resolves cross-enterprise priorities and trade-offs; and recommends whether initiatives should proceed, change course or stop based on strategic fit, risk, readiness and expected value.

Business Transformation, AI Adoption & Value Realization

Transformation Portfolio: Partners with executive and business leaders to identify and prioritize enterprise opportunities where data and AI can transform care delivery, client and employee experience, workforce capacity, productivity, quality, growth and financial performance.
Product and Delivery Accountability: Provides executive oversight for the end-to-end portfolio of analytics, automation and AI products, ensuring disciplined progression from discovery and experimentation through deployment, adoption, scaling and ongoing optimization.
Business Adoption: Establishes shared accountability with business owners for workflow redesign, change readiness, adoption and sustained use of data and AI capabilities across clinical and corporate functions.
Benefits Realization: Defines enterprise performance measures and holds the portfolio accountable for measurable clinical, operational, financial and strategic outcomes, including quality, safety, productivity, user adoption and return on investment.

Enterprise Risk, Privacy & Responsible AI

Risk Framework: Establishes the enterprise data and AI risk framework in partnership with Privacy, Legal & Compliance, Security, Clinical, Technology and other control functions, aligned with organizational risk appetite and regulatory obligations.
Responsible AI: Sets guardrails for ethical, transparent, explainable and equitable use of data and AI, including human oversight, bias monitoring, model validation, third-party risk and appropriate use of sensitive health information.
Executive Assurance: Provides executive visibility into material data and AI risks, control effectiveness, regulatory developments and emerging exposures, with clear recommendations and escalation pathways.
Ongoing Oversight: Ensures deployed data and AI products are monitored for safety, accuracy, security, performance, drift and unintended impacts, and initiates timely remediation where required.

Executive Partnership & Ecosystem Leadership

Executive Advisory: Serves as a trusted advisor to the Chief Digital Officer, CEO and senior leadership on enterprise data and AI strategy, investment choices, opportunities, risks and organizational readiness.
Enterprise Alignment: Builds shared ownership across clinical, operational, financial and corporate leaders and resolves competing priorities, dependencies and decision rights across the enterprise.
Commercial and Partner Strategy: Leads strategic vendor and partner relationships, including build-buy-partner decisions, commercial negotiations, performance governance, technology viability, cost optimization and responsible commercialization opportunities where appropriate.
External Leadership: Represents SE Health in relevant health-sector, technology, research and policy forums, strengthening strategic partnerships, sector influence and access to emerging capabilities.

People, Culture & Organizational Capability

Organizational Leadership: Designs and leads a high-performing, multidisciplinary Data & AI function with clear mandates, accountabilities, decision rights and performance expectations aligned to enterprise priorities.
Talent and Succession: Leads workforce planning, talent acquisition, leadership development, performance management and succession planning for critical data and AI capabilities, balancing internal capacity with strategic external expertise.
Enterprise Capability: Builds data literacy, responsible AI fluency and decision-making capability across the organization so leaders and teams can use data and AI confidently, safely and effectively.
Culture and Leadership: Fosters an inclusive, collaborative and accountable culture that encourages innovation, constructive challenge, continuous learning and disciplined execution.

What You Bring

Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
MBA or Master's degree in a related discipline considered an asset.(MS/MBA in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or AI).
Relevant certifications considered an asset (e.g., Azure Data/AI Engineer, AWS Certified Machine Learning, Google Cloud Data Engineer, CIPP privacy certification, CDMP, or equivalent).
15+ years of progressive technology and data leadership experience, including senior executive accountability over enterprise data systems, business intelligence, data science, and enterprise platform delivery.
Demonstrated experience designing, building, and operating modern data stack architectures (Data Warehouses, Lakehouses, MLOps platforms) within complex enterprise environments.
Proven track record of deploying machine learning models, predictive tools, or Generative AI solutions into core production workflows to drive business value.
Demonstrated experience managing financial planning, cloud consumption/compute budgets, investment prioritization, and portfolio governance for data and AI programs.
In-depth knowledge of health data standards, data privacy laws (e.g., PHIPA, PIPEDA), clinical data structures, and ethical AI/governance frameworks.
Experience establishing data governance bodies, data stewardship programs, and enterprise data quality processes.

Why Join SE Health?

At SE Health, you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of healthcare while contributing to a purpose-driven organization committed to innovation, impact, and social good. You will work alongside passionate leaders who believe that sustainable healthcare requires bold thinking, meaningful partnerships, and a relentless focus on improving lives.

Competitive Total Rewards So much more than a paycheque! Enjoy comprehensive benefits, pension, flexible pay options, car-loan support, housing solutions and exclusive staff perks.
Flexibility & Belonging Thrive with hybrid work, flexible scheduling and a supportive, inclusive culture that puts people first.
Purpose & Impact Join a national social enterprise where your voice matters. Every role helps advance health, spark innovation and strengthen communities across Canada.
Growth That Meets Your Ambition Access tuition support, training and meaningful career pathways across a growing, future-focused organization.

Join us as we transform care for generations to come.

About SE Health

SE Health is a not-for-profit social enterprise advancing health with heart. With 115+ years of impact, we bring hope, happiness and exceptional care to people and communities across Canada. We lead with empathy, dignity and purpose while building a future where everyone can realize their full health and well-being potential. We’re also an inclusive, supportive workplace offering competitive compensation, strong benefits and real opportunities to grow. We’re All In Together.

What is the opportunity?

At RBC Insurance, AI is fundamental to transforming how we operate, serve our customers, and compete in a rapidly evolving financial services landscape. To realize this opportunity, we need a visionary leader who can simultaneously architect and enable enterprise AI capabilities, modernize and enhance our data platforms, and transform our legacy integration infrastructure into a nimble, scalable foundation.

As Senior Director, AI and Data & Integration Platforms, you will own the strategy and end-to-end delivery across all three domains. You'll be responsible for building the intelligent, data-driven foundation that enables RBC Insurance to unlock AI-driven intelligence to enhance customer experiences, and fundamentally transform our business model. This is your opportunity to lead one of the most consequential technology transformations in our organization's history.

What will you do?

Own enterprise AI strategy and delivery: Develop and execute the long-term vision for AI capabilities across RBC Insurance IT and business operations. Identify frontier, game-changing AI use cases that drive competitive advantage, serve as the expert for emerging AI technologies, and position RBC Insurance as an AI-first organization.
Architect and modernize data platforms: Lead the strategic transformation of our global data foundation, stabilizing and enhancing both on-premises and cloud data platforms. Build a scalable, secure, resilient data architecture that serves as the foundation for AI, analytics, and business intelligence. Ensure data governance, quality, and accessibility across the enterprise while optimizing cost and performance.
Transform legacy integration platforms: Champion the modernization of our integration infrastructure, moving from legacy systems to API-first, event-driven architectures. Design integration platforms that enable seamless data flow, real-time decision-making, and agile business capability delivery.

10+ years of progressive leadership in AI, data, and/or technology transformation, with 5+ years leading technical teams delivering enterprise-scale IT solutions. Demonstrated track record of executing transformational business strategy and delivering measurable organizational impact.

Executive leadership and stakeholder influence: Exceptional ability to lead diverse technical teams and influence senior stakeholders through data-driven decision-making, compelling communication, and strategic facilitation. Strong executive presence and ability to operate at the C-level.

Prior experience in financial services or regulated industries, with deep understanding of compliance, risk management, and enterprise governance frameworks.

Purpose. Performance. People.

Joining CPP Investments means joining one of the world’s most admired and respected institutional investors to drive a single mandate: to deliver strong, sustainable returns for generations of Canadians.

With a long-term horizon and global reach, we deploy capital at scale across public and private markets. Our size, stability, and disciplined investment philosophy allow us to pursue complex opportunities and build enduring partnerships worldwide.

The Role

As Director, Data Engineering for the Public Markets and Alternate Assets (PMAA) team, you will build and publish the enterprise market data products that power investment strategies across our public markets and alternate assets businesses. Partnering closely with your business-aligned product owner, you will lead a talented team of data engineers and analysts and own the end-to-end lifecycle of PMAA data, from vendor and internal feeds through to trusted, well-documented data products used by investment teams, analytics platforms and AI agents. You will set the technical direction for a modern AWS data platform, establish the semantic and knowledge graph foundations that connect data across asset classes, and ensure every data product meets the standards of timeliness, quality, licensing compliance and control that investment decisions demand.

The Team

CPP Investments invests across public and private markets, supported by technology and data capabilities that enable informed investment decisions and long-term value creation.

Within PMAA, this role leads market data engineering and the development of enterprise data products that support investment professionals, quantitative and research teams. The team works with investment, product, architecture, technology and governance partners to deliver reliable, accessible and AI-ready market data.

Accountabilities

Define and execute the multi-year data engineering strategy and roadmap for PMAA market data products, partnering with the product owner to align priorities with investment needs and enterprise architecture standards.
Own the target-state AWS data platform architecture across ingestion, storage, processing, orchestration, governance and consumption, making design and build-versus-buy decisions that balance scalability, resilience, security and cost.
Lead the development and adoption of enterprise data products across public and private markets, including pricing, reference data, corporate actions and benchmarks, with clear ownership, data contracts, service levels and documentation.
Establish semantic data capabilities, including RDF knowledge graphs on Amazon Neptune, and enable governed access to AI-ready data through Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, agent skills and Amazon Quick.
Ensure reliable, timely and secure data delivery through observability, automated quality controls, incident management, AWS Lake Formation, data lineage and market data licensing and entitlement controls.
Lead agile roadmap delivery and engineering excellence, embedding CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing and reusable frameworks while engaging senior stakeholders, investment teams and strategic technology and data partners.
Build, coach and develop an inclusive, high-performing engineering team, fostering accountability, collaboration, continuous learning and career growth.

What You Bring

Undergraduate degree or college diploma in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field; a graduate degree is an asset.
10+ years of progressive experience in data engineering, data platforms or software engineering, including 5+ years leading engineering teams, with demonstrated success delivering enterprise-scale, cloud-native data platforms and leading complex agile programs.
Strong understanding of capital markets, investment management and market and reference data, including experience with major data vendors, licensing, entitlements and usage controls; private markets experience is an asset.
Advanced AWS architecture expertise equivalent to Solutions Architect – Professional, including security, IAM, networking, resilience and cost optimization, together with hands-on technical depth in Apache Spark (PySpark or Scala), AWS Glue or EMR, Airflow/MWAA, AWS DMS and Amazon RDS/Aurora.
Expertise in enterprise data product design, AWS Lake Formation governance, data contracts, service levels and consumption patterns, along with RDF, SPARQL, ontology design, Amazon Neptune, MCP servers, agent skills and AI-assisted analytics using Amazon Quick.
Ability to guide engineering teams across cloud-native development, data quality, observability and delivery practices. Experience with lakehouse technologies, Python, SQL, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, data cataloguing, financial ontologies, Amazon Bedrock or GraphRAG is an asset; relevant AWS certifications are also assets.
Inclusive people leadership, sound judgment and strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to investment professionals and executives, influence stakeholders and manage strategic vendor partnerships.

You are motivated to contribute to something larger than yourself, approach complex challenges with rigor, and hold yourself to high standards in a collaborative, performance-driven environment.

We provide colleagues with cutting-edge AI tools, dedicated learning time, and practical support to help them deliver with greater impact.

jobs.title: Director, Data Governance
jobs.description:
Nutrien is a leading provider of crop inputs and services, and our business results make a positive impact on the world. Our purpose, Feeding the Future , is the reason we come to work each day. We’re guided by our culture of care and our core values: We put safety first. We act with integrity. We are stronger together. We deliver with excellence.

Through the collective expertise of our nearly 26,000 employees, we operate a world-class network of production, distribution, and ag retail facilities. We efficiently serve growers' needs and strive to provide a more profitable, sustainable, and secure future for all stakeholders.  Help us raise the expectation of what an agriculture company can be and grow your career with Nutrien.

Nutrien is looking for a Director, Data Governance to build and lead our enterprise data governance program—strengthening data ownership, quality, and controls across key data domains so Nutrien can confidently scale analytics, AI, and digital products. Reporting to the Sr Director, Data Office, you will partner across business, technology, and risk functions to set standards, enable adoption, and ensure regulatory, and policy requirements are met globally.

This role will ensure critical data at Nutrien is trusted, consistent, and compliant across all data domains and business areas. You will operate at the intersection of business, data, technology, and risk—enabling scalable analytics, AI, and digital products globally—while ensuring regulatory and policy requirements are met and maintained.

What You'll Do

Support the design and implementation of Nutrien’s global data governance framework across core data domains (e.g., product, customer, supplier, location, and asset)
Define enterprise standards for master/reference data domains and critical data elements
Drive the implementation of governance ownership and accountability across all data domains and lines of business, partnering with domain leaders to clarify roles, responsibilities, and adoption of governance practices
Balance enterprise consistency with business needs, regulatory requirements, and regional/functional nuances
Facilitate and support enterprise and business unit data governance forums (e.g., councils and working groups) ensuring alignment, issue escalation, and effective decision making
Drive continuous improvement of governance practices as the data and AI landscape evolves
Partner with IT and to define the enterprise data quality strategy, including standards, issue management, root-cause analysis, observability and remediation
Operationalize data governance policies and standards to ensure alignment with global and regional regulatory requirements (e.g., data privacy, residency, and confidentiality), working closely with Legal, Risk, and IT partners
Lead a team delivering master data maintenance for multiple data domains at Nutrien
Partner with Legal, Risk, and Compliance to support audits, client due diligence, and regulatory inquiries related to data and analytics
Lead data governance initiatives and change adoption efforts, influencing stakeholders and enabling consistent governance practices across domains and functions

What You'll Bring

Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
15+ years of experience in data governance, data management, master data, or related enterprise data roles
5+ years of experience in a managerial role with demonstrated executive-level influence and stakeholder management, including leading governance councils and driving adoption across a matrixed organization
Proven experience building and launching a data governance program from the ground up
Experience operating in a global, matrixed organization with regional regulatory complexity
Deep knowledge of data governance concepts, frameworks, and best practices (e.g., DAMA-DMBOK)
Practical experience with ERP systems (specifically SAP), data hierarchies, and how master data is created and managed within large enterprises
Experience collaborating across multiple business areas and centralized functions within a large enterprise
Proven people leadership experience, with the ability to build, mentor, and scale a high-performing team and stewardship community

What You'll Get

Purpose-Driven Work – Make an impact as part of a global team feeding the future and support farmers locally and around the world
Excellent Benefits – Comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage, plus a retirement program with generous employer matching for your future
Grow Your Career – Tuition assistance for future education and ongoing learning and training opportunities for career advancement pathways across the organization
Support When it Matters – Employee Assistance Programs, inclusive leaves, and paid time for holidays, volunteering, vacation, and wellness
Thrive in a Strong Culture – Guided by our core values we put safety first, act with integrity, are stronger together, and deliver with excellence in a collaborative, high-performing environment

Ready to make an impact with us? Apply today!
