jobs.description:
Work Location:

Toronto, Ontario, Canada

Hours

37.5

Line Of Business

Technology Solutions

Pay Details

$165,000 - $200,000 CAD

This role is eligible for a discretionary variable compensation award that considers business and individual performance.

TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.

As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.

Job Description

Transform How Global Transaction Banking Leverages Data, Analytics & AI

As the Director, Data Platform Engineering
, you will define and execute the strategy, architecture, and engineering roadmap for the Global Transaction Banking (GTB) Data Platform
. Built on Databricks
, the platform serves as the foundation for next-generation data products, advanced analytics, AI-driven insights, regulatory reporting, and mission-critical transaction banking capabilities.

You will lead high-performing engineering teams responsible for building secure, scalable, and resilient data solutions while establishing modern engineering practices, platform standards, and delivery excellence across the organization. This role requires a technology leader who combines deep expertise in data engineering and distributed systems with a passion for developing talent, driving innovation, and delivering business outcomes at scale.

Mandate:
Own the strategy, engineering delivery, and operational excellence of the GTB Data Platform, enabling trusted data, advanced analytics, AI innovation, and next-generation transaction banking capabilities through a modern Databricks-powered ecosystem.

Key Accountabilities

Strategy & Platform Leadership

Define and execute the strategic roadmap for the GTB Data Platform, ensuring alignment with business objectives and enterprise technology strategy.
Lead the evolution of the Databricks platform, establishing a scalable, secure, and resilient foundation for analytics, data products, AI, and operational workloads.
Drive platform modernization, engineering transformation, automation, and AI-enabled development practices.
Establish engineering and data architecture standards, governance frameworks, and best practices for data, APIs, integration, and platform services.
Partner with business, product, architecture, security, infrastructure, and operations leaders to prioritize investments and accelerate business outcomes.

Engineering & Delivery Leadership

Lead multiple engineering teams responsible for data platforms, data products, APIs, streaming services, and cloud-native applications.
Oversee end-to-end delivery of strategic technology initiatives, ensuring quality, scalability, security, reliability, and operational excellence.
Provide technical leadership and oversight for architecture, system design, engineering standards, and modernization initiatives.
Drive engineering excellence through adoption of DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, reliability engineering, and platform engineering practices.
Act as the senior escalation point for critical engineering, platform, operational, and delivery issues.

Data & Technology Leadership

Champion modern data architecture practices, including data products, event-driven architectures, real-time processing, and distributed computing.
Ensure effective governance, metadata management, lineage, data quality, and platform observability across the GTB ecosystem.
Drive adoption of data and AI capabilities that improve operational efficiency, customer outcomes, and business decision-making.
Promote reuse, standardization, and scalability of platform capabilities across GTB technology domains.

Financial, Vendor & Governance Management

Accountable for platform investment planning, budget management, forecasting, and delivery performance.
Manage strategic vendor relationships and global delivery partners to achieve business and engineering objectives.
Establish governance processes, performance metrics, and operational controls to ensure transparency and predictable outcomes.
Identify and manage strategic technology, delivery, security, and operational risks.

People Leadership

Lead, coach, and develop engineering managers, architects, principal engineers, and senior technical talent.
Build a high-performing engineering organization focused on innovation, accountability, customer value, and technical excellence.
Drive workforce planning, succession management, capability development, and organizational growth.
Foster a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, ownership, and engineering craftsmanship.

Required Skills & Experience

Leadership & Technology Management

12+ years of progressive technology experience with significant experience leading large engineering teams and complex technology portfolios.
Proven success leading engineering managers, architects, and senior technical professionals.
Strong executive stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills.
Experience managing budgets, strategic investments, vendors, and large-scale transformation initiatives.

Data Platform Engineering

Deep expertise designing, building, and operating enterprise-scale data platforms.
Extensive experience with Databricks, including platform architecture, engineering, optimization, governance, and operational management.
Strong experience with Apache Spark, Delta Lake, and large-scale distributed data processing frameworks.
Deep understanding of modern data architecture, data products, metadata management, lineage, governance, and data lifecycle management.
Experience building and scaling analytical, operational, and AI-ready data platforms.

Engineering & Architecture

Strong foundation in modern programming languages (Java, Python) and API design (REST, GraphQL).
Deep understanding of distributed systems, microservices, cloud-native architectures, and enterprise integration patterns.
Strong experience with Microsoft Azure and cloud-native platform delivery.
Experience with container orchestration (Kubernetes) and DevSecOps / CI/CD practices.
Proven experience building event-driven, real-time data architectures at enterprise scale.
Working knowledge of Generative AI, LLMs, and AI-enabled engineering practices.

Nice to Have

Hands-on experience with streaming technologies such as Kafka, Confluent, Solace, or Apache Flink.
Familiarity with graph or document data models (Neo4J, MongoDB).
Experience with observability tooling such as Splunk, Dynatrace, or Datadog.
Exposure to OpenShift or other enterprise Kubernetes distributions.

Success Profile

The Successful Candidate Will

Define and execute the vision for the GTB Data Platform.
Scale and modernize a Databricks-centric data ecosystem.
Build and lead world-class data and platform engineering teams.
Deliver secure, resilient, and scalable data products and services.
Advance AI, analytics, and data-driven business capabilities.
Foster a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, and accountability.
Influence technology strategy and transformation outcomes across Global Transaction Banking.

Why Join Us

This is a highly visible leadership role with the opportunity to shape the future of data, analytics, and AI across Global Transaction Banking. You will lead the evolution of a strategic Databricks-powered platform, build exceptional engineering teams, and drive transformative outcomes that directly impact clients, products, and business growth.

Team:
You will lead distributed engineering teams across New York
, Toronto
, and Bangalore
, with global reach and cross-functional partners across the enterprise.

Who We Are

TD Securities offers a wide range of capital markets products and services to corporate, government, and institutional clients who choose us for our innovation, execution, and experience. With more than 6,500 professionals operating out of 40 cities across the globe, we strive to make every interaction, product and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple. Our services include underwriting and distributing new issues, providing trusted advice and industry-leading insight, extending access to global markets, and delivering integrated transaction banking solutions. In 2023, we acquired Cowen Inc., offering our clients access to a premier U.S. equities business and highly-diverse equity research franchise, while growing our strong, diversified investment bank.

Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

Our Total Rewards Package

Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical, and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary, variable compensation, and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off, banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition programs. Learn more

Additional Information

We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.

Please be advised that this job opportunity is subject to provincial regulation for employment purposes. It is imperative to acknowledge that each province or territory within the jurisdiction of Canada may have its own set of regulations, requirements.

Colleague Development

If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities.

If you’re passionate about helping clients and building deep, lasting relationships, TD offers diverse career paths where you can grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.

We're committed to your success and foster a respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, everyone has fair opportunities to grow, and you can unlock your full potential to achieve your career goals. Here at TD, we hire and develop the best.

Training & Onboarding

We will provide training and onboarding sessions to ensure that you’ve got everything you need to succeed in your new role.

Interview Process

We’ll reach out to candidates of interest to schedule an interview. We do our best to communicate outcomes to all applicants by email or phone call.

Accommodation

Your accessibility is important to us. Please let us know if you’d like accommodations (including accessible meeting rooms, captioning for virtual interviews, etc.) to help us remove barriers so that you can participate throughout the interview process.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Directeur.trice technique - Capture de données de jeu / Technical Director - Game Data Capture
jobs.description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

« Pour visualiser la description de poste en français, veuillez sélectionner le français dans le menu déroulant au haut de la page. »

At EA, we believe games are powerful because they bring together multiple ways people engage: play, watch, create, and connect. And increasingly, the biggest entertainment platforms aren't just places to consume content - they're places where communities build.

Creator-made content is already a proven part of EA's history - from community creation tools in Battlefield to The Gallery in The Sims 4. We believe new creative technologies and tools will expand how players engage with and contribute to our experiences, supported by thoughtful product design, safety systems, and global reach. Our focus is on enabling more players to participate in creative expression by making creation easier, safer, and more rewarding.

As a Technical Director, you will lead the technical strategy for capturing research data from EA game sources. You will define how dedicated title streams, shared instrumentation, capture builds, and downstream data systems work together as a unified capability for Research & Engineering.

You will be responsible for driving the architecture, standards, priorities, and technical outcomes of the Game Data Capture team. You will coordinate across researchers, ML Data Engineers, title teams, central infrastructure, security, and legal partners while remaining hands-on in the most consequential technical decisions.

This is a hybrid role, working three days per week in Redwood City, Montreal, or Vancouver.

You will report to the Lead Technical Director.

Responsibilities

You will define the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for a unified cross-title game-data capture capability.
You will establish standards for supported modalities, synchronization, coordinate systems, schemas, build identity, provenance, validation, and platform performance.
You will determine which capabilities belong in the shared capture platform and which require title-specific integration.
You will prioritize title onboarding and research requests based on technical feasibility, research value, dependencies, and long-term platform leverage.
You will lead architecture and design reviews for capture SDKs, title adapters, build automation, and interfaces with central data infrastructure.
You will partner with title technical leaders to secure the expertise, access, and production safeguards needed to instrument complex game codebases.
You will define requirements for dedicated Perforce streams, automated merges, reproducible builds, CI/CD, deployment, and capture validation.
You will establish clear technical acceptance criteria for certified raw capture sessions and ensure limitations are documented.
You will identify repeated title-specific needs and guide the team toward maintainable shared solutions.
You will mentor engineers, communicate technical direction, resolve cross-team decisions, and represent Game Data Capture to research and technology leadership.

Qualifications

12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including technical leadership in AAA games, game engines, real-time simulation, or related systems
Experience setting architecture and technical direction across multiple engineering teams or products
Expertise in C++ and strong working knowledge of large, multithreaded game-engine codebases
Broad experience with engine systems such as rendering, simulation, gameplay, animation, physics, audio, tools, or build pipelines
Experience integrating technology across actively developed branches, platforms, or title codebases
Experience with Perforce, complex build systems, CI/CD, and release or integration workflows
Experience translating research or product requirements into platform strategy and executable technical plans
Experience balancing rapid experimentation with security, performance, stability, maintainability, and partner-team constraints

We want to connect you with job opportunities that align with your interests, skills, and expertise. When you create an EA Careers Account and are logged into the portal, you can click “Get Recommendations” to view a curated list of job openings. These recommendations are enhanced by automated processing, including artificial intelligence, and take into account your skills and experience. However, all employment decisions are made by our hiring teams, not by automated systems.

Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

PAY RANGES

British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$169,500 - $242,600 CAD
California (depending on location e.g. Los Angeles vs. San Francisco) *$193,100 - $296,500 USD

Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

In the US, we offer a package of benefits including paid time off (3 weeks per year to start), 80 hours per year of sick time, 16 paid company holidays per year, 10 weeks paid time off to bond with baby, medical/dental/vision insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, and 401(k) to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

For Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, paid top-up to EI/QPIP benefits up to 100% of base salary when you welcome a new child (12 weeks for maternity, and 4 weeks for parental/adoption leave), extended health/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plan to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

jobs.title: Director, Data Engineering
jobs.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Director, Data Engineering

Overview

Services within Mastercard is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining customers by managing fraud and risk, enhancing cybersecurity, and improving the digital payments experience. We provide value-added services and leverage expertise, data-driven insights, and execution. The Director, Data Engineering for Cyber Analytics will be a key contributor in helping Mastercard develop and deliver actionable insights and products to mitigate cyber vulnerabilities across the Mastercard ecosystem.

Role

Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and improve data storage, pipelines, and ETL processes.
Lead the design and build of graph database solutions and data models that support cyber analytics use cases.
Partner with data scientists to understand existing ML and AI applications, identify optimization opportunities, and craft processes and solutions that streamline data engineering integration.
Oversee the integration and management of data from various sources and storage systems to produce cohesive datasets for analysis and modeling.
Partner with software engineering, IT, Info Sec, and infrastructure teams to deploy and validate production artifacts.
Lead, develop, and grow a team of highly skilled data engineers.

All About You

Strong data engineering skills, including building data pipelines and infrastructure for ML and AI applications, with a solid understanding of ML and AI concepts to build solutions together with data scientists.
Proficiency in graph databases and graph modeling techniques.
Proficiency in Databricks, Spark, and AWS, with working knowledge of on-prem distributions (Apache, Hadoop, Oracle).
Skilled in databases and big data tools such as Hive, Impala, OOZIE, Airflow, and NIFI, with working knowledge of Shell scripting and Linux/Unix systems.
Strong computer science fundamentals in object-oriented design, data structures, algorithm design, and complexity analysis.
Proven ability to lead and develop a team of data engineers.
Skilled at delegating, organizing, and motivating a team, and at prioritizing competing requests across multi-person projects.
Strong stakeholder management, with the ability to build trusted relationships across technical and business partners.
Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down ambiguous problems, propose solutions, and implement them with cross-functional teams.
Clear, persuasive communication with both technical and non-technical audiences, in writing and verbally.
Curiosity and adaptability, with the ability to learn new domains quickly and stay open to alternative ideas.

Preferred Skills

A degree in a technical field such as Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or Computer Science, or equivalent skills gained through hands-on work.
Knowledge of the payments, cyber, and/or fraud domains.
Knowledge of web crawling and scraping.
Exposure to agentic AI.

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in Canada, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive pay based on location, experience and other qualifications for the role and may be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program. This posting reflects one or more current openings on our team.

Pay Ranges

Toronto, Canada: $154,000 - $247,000 CAD

jobs.title: Director, AI Business Solutions, International Wealth Management
jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 275942

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

The Director AI Business Solutions will be responsible for guiding and implementing the AI strategy across the Canadian Wealth Management (CWM) businesses, ensuring business strategies, plans and initiatives are executed / delivered in compliance with governing regulations, internal policies and procedures.

The Director AI Business Solutions will be responsible for identifying AI initiatives that are aligned with our strategic objectives, supporting the development and implementation of artificial intelligence (AI) initiatives from start (rapid pilots, MVPs) to finish (deployed in production with user adoption). The role will be focused on process improvements, enhancements, or even reimagining them to support the evolution of CWM.

The Director AI Business Solutions will also be responsible for staying current with AI trends and technologies to drive innovation and maintain a competitive market edge in a manner that is compliant and trustworthy in alignment with Scotiabank’s Enterprise AI Governance framework. The role will leverage AI-driven analytics to optimize distribution strategies, enhance efficiency and improve user engagement by identifying patterns, and streamlining processes. This role involves working with cross-functional teams including retail and institutional distribution, finance, operations, product, technology and data.

Is this role right for you? In this role, you will:

Align CWM’s AI priorities and initiatives with leadership across the different functional business areas
Define CWM’s AI strategy, vision, and goals in alignment with CWM’s strategic business priorities
Manage AI development, demand portfolio, while maintaining an opportunity pipeline
Define objectives, metrics, KRI’s, and Key Results (OKRs) for the Business Solutions Program
Regularly report progress on key initiatives and program outcomes to CWM leadership team, providing insights and strategic recommendations to inform-decision making
Establish and manage a multi-disciplinary Business Solutions team as needed to manage and operate AI while scaling for growth
Creates an environment in which their team pursues effective and efficient operations of their respective areas in accordance with Scotiabank’s Values, its Code of Conduct and the Global Sales Principles, while ensuring the adequacy, adherence to and effectiveness of day-to-day business controls to meet obligations with respect to operational, compliance, AML/ATF/sanctions and conduct risk.
Builds a high-performance environment and implements a people strategy that attracts, retains, develops and motivates their team by fostering an inclusive work environment and using a coaching mindset and behaviours; communicating vison/values/business strategy; and, managing succession and development planning for the team.
Assess, prioritize and develop capabilities and resources required to develop, manage, and operate the AI ecosystem
Identify, develop and enhance necessary organizational AI skills and roles across leadership and business functions
Ideate, prioritize, design, test, and refine AI pilot solutions
Operate the AI practice, including the AI lifecycle, governance, and partnerships
Drive distribution efficiency and effectiveness
Develop and maintain AI use cases
Monitor AI performance and risks
Drive ROI on AI investments
Scale AI with value and re-use
Drive and sustain an AI-first innovation culture
Conduct executive AI labs to deep dive the value of AI in investment management and how to drive a culture change towards AI adoption
Align AI enablement efforts with the Enterprise AI Governance Framework, leverage best practices where available, and collaborate with AI experts within Scotiabank
Understand how the Bank’s risk appetite and risk culture should be considered in day-to-day activities and decisions.

Skills

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? - We'd love to work with you if you have:

Deep experience and knowledge of financial services and Wealth Management
Strong business judgment and ability to translate technical concepts into actionable business strategies
Excellent technical project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Familiarity with AI techniques, Frameworks and latest advances, as well as cloud and data platforms (e.g., Azure / OpenAI, Google Cloud Platform / Gemini), and the ability to leverage them for AI initiatives
Strong executive communication skills, with a collaborative and results-oriented approach
Strong leadership skills to develop and manage a team focused on driving AI initiatives
Ability to use an agile approach to develop key talent, capabilities and assets with a rapid prototyping mindset
Ability to identify opportunities, manage demand, and support the development of AI use cases
MBA, CFA and/or experience in consulting is an asset.

What's in it for you?

The opportunity to join a forward-thinking and collaborative team, surrounded by innovative thinkers. Your career matters! You will have access to career development and progression opportunities. An inclusive working environment that encourages creativity, curiosity, and celebrates success! You will get our help to save for your future and to invest in your total wellbeing through our Scotiabank benefits** such as Performance Bonus, Employee Share Ownership Program, Pension Plan Matching, Banking Benefits, and Health Benefits from day one! You will relish work-life balance, team events, and opportunities to participate in the community.

jobs.title: Director, Chapter Lead, Media Analytics
jobs.description:
We’re building a relationship-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.

At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.

To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com

What You'll Be Doing

The Marketing and Client Solutions Decision Sciences ( Growth) team is at the center of our Media practice, strategy and innovation at CIBC. Its sole focus is to efficiently drive growth in reach and conversions through efficient media investments that are data driven. We work across different enterprise teams at CIBC and Simplii helping them understand and serve our clients and Canadians better each day. We apply best practices in marketing measurement, descriptive and predictive analysis, machine learning, artificial intelligence and leverage the latest in big data technology platforms.

Reporting into the COE Lead for Marketing and Client solutions within AI Data and Analytics, this role is responsible for leading a Media decision sciences practice, delivering on strategic priorities, managing and maintaining team operations and senior stakeholder relationships, equipping the Media Ops teams with high quality and timely data and insights to continuously optimize our Media. This Director will lead, manage and mentor a small team of Junior and Media scientists. This role requires a hands-on approach to solving problems, planning and managing change related to all aspects of marketing sciences delivery.

At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You'll have the flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you'll spend 1-3 days per week on-site, while other days will be remote.

How You'll Succeed

Champion media analytics as a strategic growth driver — Serve as the trusted analytics partner to marketing, retail, wealth, and distribution leaders by translating business priorities into clear media measurement, experimentation, and optimization strategies. Ensure solutions are practical, scalable, and aligned to business outcomes.
Lead measurement, experimentation, and optimization across the media ecosystem — Oversee the design, implementation, and ongoing evaluation of analytics frameworks, models, and test-and-learn programs that improve media effectiveness. Guide the team in applying advanced analytics, AI/ML, and emerging GenAI capabilities to both structured and unstructured data, with a strong focus on campaign performance, attribution, audience insights, and investment optimization.
Deliver end-to-end analytical solutions — Lead work from problem definition and methodology through execution, validation, monitoring, and refinement. Continuously evolve approaches as business needs shift, new channels emerge, or performance insights suggest optimization opportunities.
Build a high-performing analytics function — Lead, coach, and develop a strong team of media analytics professionals. Hire and nurture talent with the right blend of analytical rigor, business acumen, and media expertise. Set clear expectations, remove barriers, and ensure the team is aligned to business priorities and enterprise goals.
Embed responsible, effective analytics practices — Foster high standards in measurement design, data quality, experimentation discipline, and responsible AI use. Ensure the team’s work adheres to relevant policies, governance standards, and best practices while maintaining credibility with partners across the organization.

Who You Are

You are a media analytics leader first. You bring strong command of the media landscape and understand how to connect channels, audiences, and investments to measurable business outcomes. You are fluent in media effectiveness, incrementality, attribution, testing, and optimization.
You combine craft expertise with strategic thinking. You know how to move from business question to analytical approach to actionable recommendation. You are comfortable shaping measurement strategies that inform planning, improve performance, and support better investment decisions.
You are highly analytical and experimentally minded. You have deep experience applying advanced analytics to marketing and media use cases, including forecasting, audience analysis, causal measurement, optimization, and performance diagnostics. You understand how to structure rigorous experiments and use evidence to guide decisions.
You are digitally and technically fluent. You are comfortable working with modern analytics and data science tools such as Python, SQL, Pandas, scikit-learn, and cloud-based data environments. You can partner effectively with technical teams while staying focused on business relevance and usability.
You are an effective translator between technical and business teams. You can turn complex analytical concepts into clear, compelling narratives for senior stakeholders. You know how to influence decisions, build trust, and bring partners along in environments with complexity and ambiguity.
You are a strong people leader. You lead with clarity, accountability, and empathy. You develop talent, elevate team capability, and create an inclusive environment where high performance and collaboration go hand in hand.
You understand applied AI in a marketing context.— You have experience using traditional AI/ML techniques and an appreciation for where GenAI can enhance workflows, insight generation, and decision support. You are thoughtful about where these tools add value and where rigor in measurement must remain paramount.
You bring strong business and industry judgment. Experience in marketing, media, or sales analytics is essential, and financial services experience is a strong asset. You understand how to operate in a regulated, complex environment while still driving innovation and impact.
You are well-credentialed and credible. You bring advanced academic training in analytics, statistics, economics, mathematics, computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, along with a track record of delivering large, high-impact analytical initiatives.
Values matter to you. You bring your real self to work, and you live our values - trust, teamwork, and accountability.

What CIBC Offers

At CIBC, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions as an employee and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career, rather than just a paycheck.

We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including a competitive salary, incentive pay, banking benefits, a benefits program*, defined benefit pension plan*, an employee share purchase plan, a vacation offering, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.
Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients.
We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day; a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.
Subject to plan and program terms and conditions

What You Need To Know

CIBC is committed to creating an inclusive environment where all team members and clients feel like they belong. We seek applicants with a wide range of abilities and we provide an accessible candidate experience. If you need accommodation, please contact Mailbox.careers-carrieres@cibc.com
CIBC is committed to clarity in our hiring process. All roles posted are opportunities we’re actively recruiting for, unless stated otherwise.

We use artificial intelligence tools during the recruitment process. Our goal for the application process is to get to know more about you, all that you have to offer, and give you the opportunity to learn more about us.

jobs.description:
Lead Transformation. Enable Innovation. Drive Business Performance.

Our client, a well-established and highly respected insurance organization, is seeking an experienced Senior Director, Technology & Operations (Business Solutions)
to play a critical leadership role in shaping the future of the business.

This position offers a unique opportunity to influence enterprise-wide strategy, operational effectiveness, digital transformation, cybersecurity, AI adoption, and business technology initiatives. Reporting to executive leadership, you will serve as the bridge between business operations and technology, ensuring solutions support organizational growth, efficiency, innovation, and exceptional customer experiences.

This role is ideal for a collaborative leader who combines strong business acumen with technology expertise and thrives in an environment where relationship building, coaching, and cross-functional leadership are essential.

What You'll Do

Strategic Leadership & Business Transformation

Partner with executive leadership to align technology and operational initiatives with business goals.
Drive enterprise-wide transformation initiatives that improve efficiency, scalability, and business performance.
Identify opportunities to leverage emerging technologies, including Artificial Intelligence and Microsoft Copilot, to enhance productivity and decision-making.
Serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, providing strategic recommendations on technology investments and operational improvements.
Champion a culture of innovation, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Technology & Business Solutions

Lead the delivery and ongoing enhancement of business applications, digital platforms, websites, and operational systems.
Oversee application development initiatives, integrations, and enhancements that support business growth and customer experience objectives.
Manage API strategies and third-party software integrations to ensure seamless connectivity across systems.
Provide oversight of SharePoint and collaboration platforms to improve knowledge sharing and operational efficiency.
Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend solutions that create measurable business value.

Cybersecurity, Risk & Governance

Collaborate with internal and external partners to strengthen cybersecurity controls and best practices.
Ensure technology solutions meet regulatory, compliance, security, and risk management requirements.
Support business continuity, data protection, and governance initiatives across the organization.

Project Management & Operational Excellence

Lead strategic projects and enterprise initiatives from concept through implementation.
Oversee project governance, prioritization, resource planning, budgeting, and execution.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives across departments and functional areas.
Establish and promote best practices in project management, change management, business analysis, and solution delivery.

Vendor & Partner Management

Manage relationships with external vendors, consultants, software providers, and strategic partners.
Lead contract negotiations, service-level agreements, and vendor performance management.
Ensure third-party partners deliver value, innovation, security, and operational excellence.

Leadership, Coaching & Team Development

Lead, mentor, coach, and develop a high-performing team of business analysts, project managers, and technology professionals.
Conduct performance reviews, establish development plans, and support employee growth and succession planning.
Foster a collaborative, open, and engaging environment that encourages teamwork and innovation.
Build strong partnerships across functional areas to ensure alignment and successful execution of strategic initiatives.
Act as a visible and approachable leader who inspires trust, accountability, and results.

Requirements

Experience & Qualifications

University degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
10+ years of progressive leadership experience in technology, operations, business solutions, digital transformation, or project management.
Experience leading enterprise-wide initiatives within insurance, financial services, or other highly regulated industries.
Strong understanding of:
Business applications and software development
Website and digital platform management
APIs and third-party system integrations
Microsoft SharePoint and collaboration technologies
Artificial Intelligence tools, including Microsoft Copilot and related productivity solutions
Cybersecurity principles, governance, and risk management
Demonstrated success leading cross-functional teams and complex organizational initiatives.
Strong vendor management and contract negotiation experience.
Experience with Agile, Lean, Continuous Improvement, or related methodologies is considered an asset.

Benefits

This is a highly visible leadership position offering the opportunity to influence strategy, modernize operations, drive technology adoption, and make a lasting impact on a growing and respected organization.

You'll work alongside an engaged executive team, lead meaningful transformation initiatives, and help shape the future direction of the business while enjoying a flexible hybrid work environment, competitive compensation package, comprehensive benefits, and long-term career growth opportunities.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Products & Platform Management
jobs.description:
This is a hybrid position (4 days a week in office from one of our office locations below and 1 day a week remote).

This opportunity can be based out of either Office Location below:

Brampton location @ 1 Presidents Choice Cir, Brampton, ON L6Y 5S5 (near hwy. 407 and Mississauga Rd)
North York location @ 243 Consumers Rd, North York, ON M2J 4W8 (near hwy. 404 and hwy. 401)

Lifemark Health Group (LHG) is a market leader in customized healthcare solutions. With over 20 years of service excellence, LHG is one of the largest, most trusted, and most comprehensive providers in Canada. As a national healthcare company, LHG employs over 5,000 highly trained clinicians, medical experts and team members in almost 400 locations coast-to-coast and continues to grow both organically as well as through acquisitions. With that growth, is a vision to be the most innovative healthcare providers in community rehabilitation, workplace health and wellness and medical assessment services. Lifemark was acquired by Loblaw Companies on May 10, 2022.

About the role:

As a senior technology and product leader, you will own the strategy, investment portfolio, architecture alignment and evolution of Lifemark’s Product & Platform ecosystem. You will translate business strategy into a multi-year product and platform roadmap that connects referral management, clinical operations, affiliate and customer partners, patients, and enterprise capabilities across Lifemark’s national care network.

The role is accountable for maximizing the value of Lifemark’s proprietary and third-party platforms, and integrated partner capabilities. You will lead the Product Management organization and work closely with Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Data & Analytics, Security and business leaders to ensure the ecosystem evolves as an integrated, modular platform rather than a collection of independently managed systems.

A key mandate is to establish a modular enterprise architecture that enables Lifemark to reuse common capabilities across products and businesses, integrate acquisitions more efficiently, and selectively build, buy or partner for new functionality. This includes defining clear platform boundaries, shared services, APIs, integration patterns, enterprise data models and reusable components that allow experiences and capabilities to evolve without requiring replacement of core systems.

Success will be measured through improved patient access, clinician productivity, clinic operational efficiency, referral performance, acquisition scalability, technology reuse and return on technology investment.

Key Responsibilities:

Product & Platform Strategy: Own the multi-year strategy and roadmap for Lifemark’s integrated Product & Platform ecosystem, aligned to enterprise growth, clinical and operational priorities.
Enterprise Architecture & Platform Evolution: Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Engineering to define the target-state architecture for the ecosystem, including platform boundaries, shared services, APIs, integration patterns, dataflowsand technology standards.
Modular Capability Strategy: Establish a modular approach to product development, identifying common capabilities that can be developed once and reused proprietary platforms, acquisition businesses and future platforms. Examples may include scheduling, identity and access, communications, billing, payments, document management, reporting, patient engagement and workflow services.
Build, Buy, Partner & Integrate: Determine where Lifemark should build proprietary capabilities, leverage third-party solutions, establish strategic partnerships or integrate existing enterprise platforms while preserving control of strategically important systems and data.
Portfolio & Investment Management: Prioritize investments across products, platforms and shared capabilities based on business value, strategic fit, architectural alignment, capacity, risk and ROI.
High-Performing Product Organization: Build, lead and develop Product Managers, Business Solution Managers and Business Systems Analysts and establish consistent product-management disciplines across the organization.
Business Outcomes: Establish measurable product outcomes and ensure roadmap investments deliver improvements in clinician productivity, patient experience, referral performance, operational efficiency and network scalability.
Product Discovery & Customer Insight: Establish continuous feedback loops with end users and enterprise stakeholders; use research, analytics and experimentation to inform priorities.
Cross-Product Experience & Interoperability: Ensure workflows operate seamlessly across systems, reducing duplicate capabilities, manual hand-offs and fragmented user experiences.
Enterprise Data & Analytics: Partner with Data & Analytics and Architecture to ensure products contribute to a common enterprise data foundation that enables network-wide operational visibility, advancedanalyticsand future AI capabilities.
Delivery Partnership: Partner with Engineering and Architecture leaders to translate product strategy into executable plans while balancing modernization, new capabilities, technical debt, platform health and delivery capacity.
AI & Automation: Identify, prioritize and scale AI-enabled and automated capabilities that deliver measurable improvements in clinical workflows, operational efficiency and decision-making.
Vendor & Strategic Partnerships: Own product-level strategy and value realization for third-party technology partners, ensuring vendor roadmaps and architectures align with Lifemark’s target-state ecosystem.
Financial Management: Own product and platform budgets, business cases, investment approvals and benefit realization.
Risk, Privacy & Compliance: Ensure products, integrations and shared platform capabilities meet healthcare privacy, cybersecurity, regulatory and enterprise risk requirements.
Executive Communication & Governance: Provide senior leadership with clear visibility into portfolio priorities, architectural decisions, investment trade-offs, dependencies and business outcomes.

What we're looking for:

10+ years of progressive experience across digital product,technologyor platform leadership, including 5+ years leading multi-disciplinary product organizations.
Demonstrated experience developing product and platform strategies across complex, interconnected technology ecosystems.
Strong understanding of enterprise architecture concepts, modular platform design, APIs, shared services, integrationpatternsand reusable capabilities.
Experience partnering closely with Enterprise Architecture and Engineering teams to translate business strategy into scalable technology platforms.
Experience making build, buy,partnerand integrate decisions across proprietary and third-party platforms.
Experience with Practice Management Systems, Electronic Medical Records or healthcare technology ecosystems is an asset, including scheduling, clinical documentation,billingand patient engagement.
Demonstrated ability to apply and scale AI/ML and automation to improve business and clinical outcomes.
Strong financial and portfolio-management skills, including business cases, investmentprioritizationand benefit realization.
Excellent executive stakeholder communication, outcome-based roadmapping , organizational design and talent development.

Our Perks:

Eligible to earn an annual Short-Term-Incentive Plan
Have access to a yearly education re-imbursement fund
Receive 30% discount from Shopper Drug Mart purchases
Contribute to an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) with employer matching percentage
Have paid vacation days as well as wellness days
Have a choice to enroll in our Health & Dental Flex Life Benefits (or in lieu contribute to your RRSPs)
Annual Bonus Incentive
Access to employee assistance program
On-site gym, Basketball & Volleyball courts, Ice Rink, Groceries delivered to work via PC Express, Dry-Cleaning services (1 Presidents Choice Circle Office)

Lifemark welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Lifemark promotes equal employment opportunities for all job applicants, including those self-identifying as a member of the following groups: Indigenous peoples, Newcomers to Canada, and Visible minorities.

jobs.title: Vice President, Product Management, Platform & Innovation
jobs.description:
At Appfire, we believe that great work happens when people get to choose how they work. After 20 years of creating software that empowers teams to break silos and collaborate seamlessly, we've learned that one size does not fit all. We're a team of 800+ employees, working remotely across 28 countries. Our flagship products include: JXL, Comala Document Management, 7Pace Time Tracker, Jira Misc Workflow Extensions, and BigPicture.

Here you can read some of our customer stories: https://appfire.com/resources/resource-library/customer-stories

Appfire is seeking a Vice President, Product Management, Platform & Innovation
to lead three connected areas central to the company's next phase of growth: the Appfire Platform, the Innovation portfolio, and Appfire's technical product relationship with Atlassian.

You will define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Appfire Platform
, the shared services and AI capabilities that power our products, accelerate delivery, and create leverage across the portfolio. You will also lead the Innovation team
, responsible for discovering, validating, incubating, and launching the next generation of Appfire products.

As Appfire's senior product leader for the technical dimension of our Atlassian relationship, you will anticipate platform, API, Forge, and Marketplace changes; represent Appfire in technical and roadmap discussions; and translate ecosystem shifts into competitive advantage, product opportunity, and managed risk.

As a member of the Product Leadership Team, you will help shape strategy across the broader portfolio, translate company priorities into focused product bets, and build a high-performing team of product leaders. You will partner closely with Engineering, Go-to-Market, Finance, Legal, Security, and executive leadership.

Success will be measured by the adoption and business impact of platform capabilities, the quality and velocity of the innovation pipeline, and the revenue and strategic value created by new products launched through your team.

Key Accountabilities

Strategy and Portfolio Leadership

Partner with executive leadership to establish a compelling vision for the Appfire Platform and new-product portfolio as part of the broader company strategy.
Translate that vision into a clear investment thesis, product roadmap, measurable objectives, and operating plan.
Make disciplined decisions about where to build, buy, partner, invest, scale, or stop.
Maintain a clear view of progress, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs, adjusting priorities as market and business conditions change.

Company Description

Headquartered in Montreal, Detroit and Munich, Vention helps manufacturers automate their operations in record time with the only hardware and software AI-powered platform built for the factory floor. Our technology powers over 25,000 machines across 4,000 factories across 5 continents and we have the privilege to work with a significant proportion of Fortune 500 manufacturers, from space rockets, to electrical cars, to robotics.

At Vention, you’ll work alongside driven and talented people who care deeply about their craft and the impact they create. We’re a team of high achievers who grow through meaningful work, solving complex challenges, learning fast, and seeing the results of our efforts every day.

We move quickly and aim high, but we do it together with care, collaboration, and respect. Our culture celebrates diverse perspectives and supports your growth through intentional development, strong leadership, and opportunities to make a real difference.

What You’ll Do

This is not a traditional SaaS product leadership role.

Vention's software platform sits at the intersection of industrial automation, robotics, developer tools, cloud software, embedded systems and Physical AI. Our products are tightly interconnected, with decisions in one part of the stack often creating significant implications elsewhere.

The VP Product will lead a team of Product Managers and UI/UX Designers across a broad portfolio including:

MachineBuilder — 3D machine design and configuration
MachineLogic — Robot programming and automation development
Simulation — machine and robot simulation
Robot Control — real-time control and orchestration
Physical AI — AI-powered automation capabilities
Web & eCommerce — digital purchasing and configuration experience
RemoteSupport & RemoteView — remote machine support and operation
MachineAnalytics — machine data, monitoring and intelligence

The mandate is simple: make Vention's software dramatically better while dramatically increasing the velocity at which we ship it.

You will bring product rigor and leadership to an organization where the CEO and CTO remain deeply involved in product direction. Your role is therefore not to simply "own the roadmap." It is to become the operating engine that translates strategic direction into an exceptional product vision, clear priorities and fast execution.

Set the Product Vision & Experience
Define the long-term product vision across Vention's entire software platform.
Establish a coherent product strategy spanning design, programming, simulation, robotics, AI, eCommerce and machine operations.
Raise the bar for simplicity, usability and design quality across the platform, with an Apple-like obsession for product excellence.
Establish product principles and UX standards that make a highly sophisticated technology stack feel simple and intuitive.
Translate company-level strategic direction into a clear, differentiated product vision and roadmap.
Drive Product Velocity & Execution
Dramatically accelerate the pace at which Vention turns ideas into shipped products.
Establish a high-performance product operating cadence focused on fast decisions, clear accountability and measurable outcomes.
Ruthlessly prioritize initiatives based on customer impact, strategic value and business outcomes.
Remove organizational and process bottlenecks that slow product development.
Build a culture where Product, Engineering and Design are accountable for shipping—not simply planning.
Orchestrate the Platform Roadmap
Own prioritization across a highly integrated portfolio of software, firmware, robotics and Physical AI products.
Manage dependencies and sequencing across MachineBuilder, MachineLogic, simulation, robot control, firmware, analytics, RemoteView, RemoteSupport and eCommerce.
Balance customer-facing features, foundational technology investments, technical debt and emerging opportunities.
Resolve competing priorities across product teams and make difficult trade-offs quickly.
Ensure individual product roadmaps collectively move the Vention platform forward as one integrated system.
Lead Product, Design & Technical Product Management
Lead, develop and scale a high-performing organization of Product Managers and UI/UX Designers.
Raise the technical depth, product judgment and execution standards of the product organization.
Partner closely with Engineering to make sound architectural and product trade-offs.
Stay sufficiently technical to dive into architecture, APIs, code and system design when required.
Develop product leaders who can operate independently while maintaining alignment with Vention's overall product strategy.

What You Bring To The Table

Exceptional product leader with 12+ years of experience in product, software or technology leadership, including significant experience managing multiple product teams.
Deep technical credibility with the ability to understand software architecture, APIs, distributed systems, embedded systems and technical trade-offs—and to go into the code when necessary.
Broad platform experience managing complex, highly integrated products where decisions and dependencies span multiple teams and technology layers.
Outstanding product taste with an instinct for simplicity, elegance, consistency and intuitive user experiences; a genuine obsession with design quality and product perfection.
Proven execution track record with a bias toward action, demonstrated ability to accelerate roadmaps, make decisions quickly and consistently turn strategy into shipped products.
Exceptional prioritization skills with the ability to make difficult trade-offs across competing customer needs, technical investments, product opportunities and business priorities.
Strong systems thinker who can understand how individual products, technologies and teams fit together into a coherent platform and architecture.
Customer- and business-oriented with the ability to balance customer value, strategic differentiation, revenue impact and long-term platform investments.
Strong people leader who can attract, develop and inspire exceptional Product Managers and UI/UX Designers while raising the overall bar for product talent and accountability.
Comfortable operating in a highly engaged leadership environment, able to partner effectively with the CEO, CTO and other leaders while bringing structure, clarity and independent judgment to product execution.
Passion for robotics, AI and industrial technology, with genuine curiosity about how software, robotics, Physical AI and hardware can converge to transform automation.
High ownership and low ego: intellectually rigorous, direct, pragmatic and willing to dive into the details when required to solve a problem.

What We Offer

Career pathing: Real opportunities to grow through personalized development plans, bi-annual employee reviews, and mentorship program
Professional development: Continuous training in performance management, inclusive leadership, leadership operating model, team building, and giving/receiving feedback
Gender diversity & inclusion: Pay equity reviews, inclusive policies, and a Women’s Employee Resource Group offering networking, mentorship, and quarterly learning sessions.
Hybrid work: Enjoy flexibility with our hybrid model, allowing you to work from home on select days.
Community engagement: Two paid volunteering days per year to give back to causes you care about.
Team events: All year round employee events including annual kick-off, employee summit, quarterly happy hours, and department events.
Comprehensive benefits: A complete group benefits plan for you and your family that start day one.
Top-up and benefits for new parents: Additional financial support and resources to support employees during their transition to parenthood.

What To Expect In Your Interview

Decision & Offer

We’re committed to making every step of the process inclusive and accessible. If you require accommodations at any stage, please let us know, we’ll ensure you have what you need to succeed.

Vention’s culture

Vention is an uplifting environment for high achievers. Thinking that Vention’s culture would keep you energized? See our full culture guide here

Demo Day 2025

Culture Video

Description De L’entreprise

Basée à Montréal, Detroit et Munich, Vention aide les fabricants à automatiser leurs opérations en un temps record grâce à la seule plateforme matérielle et logicielle alimentée par l’IA conçue pour l’usine. Notre technologie alimente plus de 25 000 machines dans 4 000 usines réparties sur 5 continents, et nous avons le privilège de collaborer avec une grande proportion des fabricants du Fortune 500, allant de la construction de fusées à l’automobile électrique, en passant par la robotique.

Chez Vention, vous travaillerez aux côtés de personnes passionnées et talentueuses qui ont à cœur leur métier et l’impact qu’elles créent. Nous formons une équipe de personnes ambitieuses qui évoluent grâce à un travail porteur de sens, en relevant des défis complexes, en apprenant rapidement et en constatant chaque jour les résultats de leurs efforts.

Nous avançons vite et visons haut, mais nous le faisons ensemble, avec soin, collaboration et respect. Notre culture valorise la diversité des perspectives et soutient votre développement grâce à un encadrement intentionnel, un leadership fort et des occasions concrètes de faire une réelle différence.

Ce Que Vous Ferez

Il ne s'agit pas d'un rôle de leadership de produit SaaS traditionnel.

La plateforme logicielle de Vention se situe à l'intersection de l'automatisation industrielle, de la robotique, des outils pour développeurs, des logiciels infonuagiques, des systèmes embarqués et de l'IA physique (Physical AI). Nos produits sont étroitement interconnectés, et les décisions prises dans une partie de l'architecture technologique (stack) ont souvent des implications importantes ailleurs.

Le Ou La VP Produit Dirigera Une Équipe De Gestionnaires De Produits Et De Designers UI/UX à Travers Un Vaste Portefeuille Comprenant

MachineBuilder — Conception de machines en 3D et configuration
MachineLogic — Programmation de robots et développement de l'automatisation
Simulation — Simulation de machines et de robots

Web & eCommerce (Commerce électronique) — Expérience numérique d'achat et de configuration
RemoteSupport & RemoteView — Soutien et exploitation de machines à distance
MachineAnalytics — Données de machines, surveillance et intelligence

Le mandat est simple : rendre les logiciels de Vention considérablement meilleurs, tout en augmentant de façon draconienne la vitesse à laquelle nous les livrons (ship).

Vous apporterez de la rigueur et du leadership en matière de produit au sein d'une organisation où le PDG (CEO) et le Chef de la technologie (CTO) restent profondément impliqués dans l'orientation du produit. Votre rôle ne consistera donc pas simplement à « posséder la feuille de route » (roadmap). Il s'agira de devenir le moteur opérationnel qui traduit l'orientation stratégique en une vision de produit exceptionnelle, avec des priorités claires et une exécution rapide.

Définir la vision et l'expérience produit
Définir la vision produit à long terme pour l'ensemble de la plateforme logicielle de Vention.
Établir une stratégie de produit cohérente couvrant la conception, la programmation, la simulation, la robotique, l'IA, le commerce électronique et les opérations des machines.
Rehausser la barre en matière de simplicité, de convivialité et de qualité de conception sur l'ensemble de la plateforme, avec une obsession de l'excellence produit digne d'Apple.
Établir des principes de produit et des normes d'expérience utilisateur (UX) qui rendent une architecture technologique haut

jobs.description:
Director, CX AI Delivery

Who We Are

Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture

With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, Africa, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across eight core service areas: Digital Product Consulting, Digital Marketing Services, Data & AI, Strategy Consulting, Business Operations Modernization, Enterprise Applications, Cloud Engineering, and QA & Test Engineering.

From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.

Location & Flexibility

This role will operate remotely in the United States
or Canada
OR be based out of one of our major North American office locations - Charlottesville, VA, Durham, NC, Columbus, OH, Boston, MA, Toronto, ON, or Vancouver, BC.

This role may involve travel of up to 25% to contact center and client locations.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Director, CX AI Delivery
: a consultant and delivery expert who can turn complex contact center and AI programs into predictable, measurable outcomes. You will lead delivery across our CX AI portfolio, spanning Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) platforms, conversational and agentic AI, agent assist, and CX intelligence, and serve as a trusted advisor to client executives. You will manage a portfolio of client engagements (generally ~$15–20M in revenue), directly lead delivery, product, and engineering leaders, and step in to stabilize and recover programs when needed.

This is a delivery-first leadership role with an AI lens. You will bring the rigor of a seasoned delivery executive together with a working command of how AI is changing CX: from AI-driven routing and virtual agents to copilots, knowledge, and agentic automation. You will help clients adopt these capabilities responsibly, at scale, and in iterative releases that get value into production quickly. You will also help evaluate vendor and partner solutions and decide how and when new tools enter the ecosystem.

This position reports to the Managing Director, CX AI Delivery and typically manages 8–12 direct reports, including senior managers, managers, and principal-level delivery and technical leaders. It is primarily evaluated on delivery success, client and team feedback, forecast accuracy, portfolio profitability, and growth of key accounts. This is an opportunistically billable position.

Responsibilities

Strategic Account Governance & Growth

Be the executive partner. Act as the primary escalation point and strategic advisor for client executives, ensuring TELUS Digital is viewed as a “Doctor” (consultative partner), not a “Waiter” (order taker).
Run portfolio health. Drive the commercial success of a ~$15–20M portfolio, leading Quarterly Business Reviews that connect delivery progress to the client’s long-term CX and business goals.
Grow organically. Identify expansion opportunities in existing accounts by understanding client pain points and bringing a relevant point of view on CX and AI. Support renewals, upsell, and expansion in partnership with strategic sales and customer success teams.
Extend into managed services and advisory as the practice matures: shape Day 2 support models, operational readiness, and advisory engagements that keep clients engaged after go-live.

Delivery Excellence & Risk Mitigation

Lead a global, multidisciplinary team across multiple concurrent workstreams, ensuring product, engineering, and delivery leaders operate as a cohesive unit to deliver measurable outcomes.
Manage risk proactively. Identify “red” and “yellow” programs early; step into recovery situations to provide clarity, reset expectations, and stabilize teams and client relationships.
Push for iterative delivery. Favor smaller releases and faster cycles over big-bang launches, especially for AI capabilities where learning in production is essential.
Optimize delivery models, balancing onshore/offshore teams, automation, and repeatable assets to improve margins and scalability.
Manage vendor and partner ecosystems. Work with CCaaS and AI platform partners (e.g., Genesys, Google, AWS, Zendesk, Five9, ElevenLabs, Cresta, Parloa) to deliver joint solutions as well as surrounding services in the client ecosystem.
Partner on pre-sales. Support the commercial team to shape innovative solutions and lead scoping, estimation, and handoffs into delivery so engagements start with clear requirements and goals.

Leadership & Talent Development

Coach and mentor delivery, product, and engineering leaders on leading their own teams and navigating complex client dynamics.
Build a high-performance culture with regular 1:1s and performance reviews grounded in radical candor and growth, delivering feedback upward, across, and down with grace and clarity.
Raise the bar on talent. Participate in senior-level hiring, contribute to the Delivery Playbook, and build career paths and skill development (including AI and platform certification pipelines).

Operational & Financial Stewardship

Own portfolio financials: gross margin, utilization, and effective billable rates.
Forecast accurately. Maintain precise revenue and resource forecasts so the business can plan hiring and growth with confidence.
Influence with data. Use reporting language, data visualization, and storytelling to influence internal and external decisions and inspire confidence in stakeholders.
Collaborate across the business with peers and practice leaders to improve internal processes and operational efficiency, and bring energy to moments that matter: new relationships, key presentations, and recovery situations.

Qualifications

10+ years in the technology industry, including 4+ years in a senior leadership role in a professional services, consulting, or agency environment.
Proven record managing a diverse portfolio of client accounts (ideally $10M+ in annual revenue) with a focus on retention and organic growth.
Experience delivering large-scale CX or contact center transformations that influenced VP- and C-level decision making.
Working knowledge of how AI is applied in CX: conversational and voice AI, agent assist and copilots, AI-driven routing, knowledge and content for AI, and CX intelligence; ability to discuss architecture, risk, and ROI credibly with both technical and executive audiences.
Hands-on delivery experience with one or more leading CCaaS or CX AI platforms (e.g., Genesys, Amazon Connect, Zendesk, Google); platform certifications and experience across multiple verticals are a plus.
Deep understanding of the SDLC and Agile delivery, with a track record of leading complex, custom-built software solutions from discovery to launch, and comfort with iterative, experiment-driven delivery.
Experience managing and coaching leaders across Product, Engineering, and Delivery, and leading large, globally distributed teams.
Strong command of professional services metrics, including gross margin, utilization, forecast accuracy, and effective billable rates.
Exceptional ability to navigate “recovery situations” and high-stakes client conversations with poise, clarity, and a solution-oriented mindset.
Ability to translate complex delivery data into compelling narratives for QBRs and executive stakeholders.
Understanding of regulatory requirements in contact center operations (e.g., PCI, HIPAA, TCPA, PIPEDA) is a plus.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

We will only use the information you provide to process your application and to produce tracking statistics. Since we do not request personal data deemed sensitive, we ask you to abstain from sharing that information with us.

For more information on how we use your information, see our Privacy Policy.

Mandate and Decision Rights

Own the integrated technology delivery plan for Em from discovery and architecture through build, evaluation, release, operation, and continuous improvement.
Jointly commit scope, sequencing, release outcomes, and delivery forecasts with the Product Owner, balancing client value, technical feasibility, risk, cost, and capacity.
Make or escalate timely technology delivery decisions across architecture, engineering, environments, data, integration, testing, controls, and production readiness.
Hold delivery teams and partners accountable for agreed outcomes, quality standards, dependencies, and evidence-based release criteria.
Protect the product from unmanaged technical debt, fragmented ownership, late-stage controls, and delivery practices that are not fit for AI.

Key Responsibilities

End-to-End Technology Delivery

Drive delivery discipline across scope, schedule, cost, quality, resources, risk, and benefits, using forecasts rather than artificial certainty.

AI Engineering and AI SDLC Leadership
